decisions.choice: spoke to Moses. He said (Balanced); said to Moses (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "spoke ... saying" is the usual way of introducing the LORD's words to Moses. Literal keeps both verbs. Balanced keeps "spoke" and starts the speech with "He said", as Leviticus does; Readable says it once.

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative at Literal and Balanced ("parla", "dit", "firent"); passé composé at Readable ("a dit", "ont fait")
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Numbers: the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative, and Readable uses the passé composé of spoken and school French. The laws inside the LORD's speeches use the future at Literal and Balanced and "devoir" or the imperative at Readable.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter (5:25 at Readable)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalizes pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው፦" (Literal); "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሙሴን እንዲህ አለው፦" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The formula as in Numbers 8:1 and 17:1: Literal keeps "spoke ... saying" with "ተናገረው ... እንዲህ ሲል" and the "and" as "-ም"; Balanced and Readable say it once. It returns at 5:5 and 5:11.

records.literal_gloss: Command [the] sons of Israel, and they shall send away from the camp every [one] stricken with scale disease, and every [one] having a discharge, and every [one] unclean by a [dead] person.

en.L: "Command the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel that they send out of the camp everyone with scale disease, and everyone with a discharge, and everyone unclean through a dead person.
en.B: "Command the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} to send out of the camp anyone who has a serious skin disease or a discharge, and anyone made unclean by a dead body.
en.R: "Command the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} to send certain people out of the camp. This means anyone with a serious skin disease, anyone with a discharge from the body, and anyone who is unclean because of a dead body.

es.L: «Manda a los hijos de Israel que echen del campamento a todo el que tenga enfermedad de la piel, a todo el que tenga flujo y a todo el que esté impuro por un muerto.
es.B: «Ordena a los israelitas que echen fuera del campamento a cualquiera que tenga una enfermedad grave de la piel o un flujo, y a cualquiera que haya quedado impuro por un cadáver.
es.R: «Ordena a los israelitas que saquen del campamento a ciertas personas: a cualquiera que tenga una enfermedad grave de la piel, a cualquiera que tenga un flujo del cuerpo y a cualquiera que esté impuro por causa de un cadáver.

fr.L: « Ordonne aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël qu’ils renvoient du camp quiconque est atteint d’une maladie de peau, quiconque a un écoulement, et quiconque est impur à cause d’un mort.
fr.B: « Ordonne aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} de renvoyer du camp toute personne qui a une maladie de peau grave ou un écoulement, et toute personne rendue impure par un cadavre.
fr.R: « Ordonne aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} de faire sortir certaines personnes du camp : celles qui ont une maladie de peau grave, celles qui ont un écoulement du corps, et celles qui sont impures à cause d’un cadavre.

sw.L: "Waamuru wana wa Israeli kwamba wamtoe nje ya kambi kila mwenye ugonjwa wa ngozi, na kila anayetokwa na majimaji, na kila aliye najisi kwa sababu ya maiti.
sw.B: "Waamuru Waisraeli wamtoe nje ya kambi yeyote aliye na ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi au anayetokwa na majimaji, na yeyote aliyetiwa unajisi na maiti.
sw.R: "Waamuru Waisraeli wawatoe watu fulani nje ya kambi. Hao ni mtu yeyote mwenye ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi, yeyote anayetokwa na majimaji mwilini, na yeyote aliye najisi kwa sababu ya maiti.

vi.L: "Hãy truyền cho con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đuổi ra khỏi trại quân mọi người mắc bệnh ngoài da nghiêm trọng, mọi người bị chảy dịch, và mọi người bị ô uế vì một người chết.
vi.B: "Hãy truyền cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phải đưa ra khỏi trại quân bất cứ ai mắc bệnh ngoài da nghiêm trọng hoặc bị chảy dịch, và bất cứ ai bị ô uế vì đụng đến xác chết.
vi.R: "Hãy truyền cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đưa một số người ra khỏi khu trại. Đó là những người mắc bệnh ngoài da nghiêm trọng, những người bị chảy dịch từ thân thể, và những người bị ô uế vì đụng đến xác chết.

ko.L: "이스라엘 자손에게 명령하여, 악성 피부병이 든 자와 유출이 있는 자와 죽은 사람 때문에 부정해진 자를 모두 진 밖으로 내보내게 하여라.
ko.B: "이스라엘 백성에게 명령하여, 악성 피부병이 있거나 유출이 있는 사람과 시신 때문에 부정해진 사람을 모두 진 밖으로 내보내게 하여라.
ko.R: "이스라엘 사람들에게 명령하여, 어떤 사람들을 진 밖으로 내보내게 해야 한다. 곧 악성 피부병이 있는 사람과, 몸에서 무엇이 흘러나오는 사람과, 시신 때문에 부정해진 사람이다.

pt.L: "Ordena aos filhos de Israel que mandem para fora do acampamento todo o que tem doença escamosa, e todo o que tem fluxo, e todo o que está impuro por causa de um morto.
pt.B: "Ordena aos israelitas que mandem para fora do acampamento todo aquele que tiver uma doença de pele grave ou um fluxo, e todo aquele que tiver ficado impuro por causa de um cadáver.
pt.R: "Ordena aos israelitas que mandem algumas pessoas para fora do acampamento: quem tiver uma doença de pele grave, quem tiver um fluxo que sai do corpo e quem estiver impuro por ter tocado num morto.

am.L: «የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዝ፤ ለምጽ ያለበትን ሁሉ፣ ፈሳሽ ያለበትንም ሁሉ፣ በሰው ሬሳ የረከሰውንም ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ያስወጡ።
am.B: «ከባድ የቆዳ በሽታ ወይም ፈሳሽ ያለበትን ሰው ሁሉ፣ በሬሳም የረከሰውን ሰው ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ እንዲያስወጡ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዛቸው።
am.R: «እስራኤላውያንን እዘዛቸው፤ አንዳንድ ሰዎችን ከሰፈሩ ማስወጣት አለባቸው። እነዚህም ከባድ የቆዳ በሽታ ያለበት፣ ከሰውነቱ ፈሳሽ የሚወጣውና ሬሳ በመንካቱ የረከሰው ሰው ሁሉ ናቸው።

decisions.choice: stricken with scale disease: one of a range of skin conditions that made a person unclean
decisions.reason: The word covers the skin conditions described in Leviticus 13-14, marked by sores, scales or patches, and it is also used of mold on cloth and walls (Leviticus 13:47; 14:34). It is not the same as the disease now called leprosy (Hansen's disease). Leviticus 13:46 already tells such a person to live outside the camp.

decisions.choice: having a discharge: an abnormal flow from the genitals
decisions.reason: Leviticus 15 deals with discharges from the body that made a man or a woman unclean for a time and had to be cleansed with washing and offerings (Leviticus 15:2-15, 25-30).

decisions.choice: unclean by a person: unclean through contact with a dead body
decisions.reason: The word usually means a living person or life, but in this phrase it means a dead person (Leviticus 21:1; Numbers 6:6; 9:6). Numbers 19:11-16 explains that touching a body, or being in the tent where someone has died, makes a person unclean for seven days.

decisions.choice: the camp: the place where the LORD lives among his people
decisions.reason: The three kinds of uncleanness are sent outside the camp because the LORD dwells in it (verse 3). The camp had just been ordered around the tabernacle (chapters 2-4), and what was unclean could not stay near the holy place (Leviticus 15:31).

decisions.choice: a serious skin disease
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the narrower "scale disease". Balanced and Readable use "serious skin disease", as Leviticus 13 does, and avoid "leprosy", which names a different disease today.

decisions.choice: "maiti" for the dead person
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "a person" but means a dead one (m3). "Maiti" is the ordinary Swahili word for a human corpse; "mzoga" is used of a dead animal.

decisions.choice: "bệnh ngoài da nghiêm trọng" (scale disease)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's choice, as Leviticus 13-14 uses it: the Hebrew word covers several skin conditions and is not modern leprosy, so the traditional "phong" is not used.

decisions.choice: "bị chảy dịch" for "having a discharge"
decisions.reason: The wording of Leviticus 15:2 in Vietnamese, which names the flow without naming a particular disease.

decisions.choice: "악성 피부병" for the scale disease at every level; "유출" (Literal, Balanced) and "몸에서 무엇이 흘러나오는" (Readable) for the discharge
decisions.reason: The term sheet and Korean Leviticus 13-15 use "악성 피부병"; "나병", the word of older Korean Bibles, names one disease (leprosy), while the Hebrew covers a range of skin conditions, as the footnoted meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: doença escamosa (L); uma doença de pele grave (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Leviticus 13 says it in Portuguese: Literal "doença escamosa" for the English Literal "scale disease"; Balanced and Readable "uma doença de pele grave" (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md), not "lepra", since m1 says it is not the disease now called leprosy.

decisions.choice: impuro por ter tocado num morto
alternatives: impuro por causa de um cadáver
decisions.reason: Readable says how a dead body makes a person unclean, by touching it (m3), where the English Readable says "because of a dead body"; being in the tent where someone died (Numbers 19:14) is the less common case and is not lost from the meaning note.

decisions.choice: "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (L, B) and "እስራኤላውያን" (R), with no gender span, through the chapter
decisions.reason: Amharic "ልጆች" (children) already includes daughters, so the English gender span has nothing to change (the Pentateuch terms list).

decisions.choice: "ለምጽ" (L); "ከባድ የቆዳ በሽታ" (B, R) for tsaraʿat
decisions.reason: The terms list's choice: the Hebrew names a range of skin conditions that made a person unclean (m1), not only what is now called leprosy, which "ለምጽ" suggests to a modern reader. Literal keeps the traditional word.

source.text: מִזָּכָ֤ר עַד־נְקֵבָה֙ תְּשַׁלֵּ֔חוּ אֶל־מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה תְּשַׁלְּח֑וּם וְלֹ֤א יְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת־מַ֣חֲנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: From male to female you shall send away; to outside of the camp you shall send them away, and not they shall defile their camps, which I [am] dwelling in their midst.

en.L: From male to female you shall send [them] away; outside the camp you shall send them, and they shall not defile their camps, where I dwell in their midst."
en.B: Whether male or female, you must send them out and put them outside the camp. Then they will not defile the camps of the people in whose midst I dwell."
en.R: Send away both men and women. Make them stay outside the camp. Then they will not make the camp unclean, because I live there among them."

es.L: Desde el varón hasta la mujer los {{plural_you:echarán|echaréis}}; fuera del campamento los {{plural_you:echarán|echaréis}}, y no contaminarán sus campamentos, en medio de los cuales yo habito».
es.B: Sea varón o mujer, los {{plural_you:echarán|echaréis}} y los {{plural_you:pondrán|pondréis}} fuera del campamento. Así no contaminarán los campamentos del pueblo en medio del cual yo habito».
es.R: {{plural_you:Echen|Echad}} fuera tanto a hombres como a mujeres. {{plural_you:Háganlos|Hacedlos}} quedarse fuera del campamento. Así no harán impuro el campamento, porque yo vivo allí, en medio de ellos».

fr.L: De l’homme jusqu’à la femme, vous [les] renverrez ; hors du camp vous les renverrez, et ils ne souilleront pas leurs camps, au milieu desquels j’habite. »
fr.B: Homme ou femme, vous les renverrez et les mettrez hors du camp. Ainsi ils ne souilleront pas les camps du peuple au milieu duquel j’habite. »
fr.R: Renvoyez les hommes comme les femmes. Faites-les rester hors du camp. Ainsi, ils ne rendront pas le camp impur, car j’habite là, au milieu d’eux. »

sw.L: Mwanamume hadi mwanamke mtawatoa; nje ya kambi mtawatoa, nao hawatazitia unajisi kambi zao, ambazo {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninakaa katikati yao."
sw.B: Mwanamume au mwanamke, mtawatoa na kuwaweka nje ya kambi, ili wasizitie unajisi kambi za watu ambao {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninakaa katikati yao."
sw.R: Watoeni wanaume na wanawake pia. Wakae nje ya kambi. Hivyo hawataifanya kambi kuwa najisi, kwa sababu ninaishi humo pamoja nao."

vi.L: Từ nam đến nữ, các ngươi phải đuổi [họ] đi; các ngươi phải đuổi họ ra ngoài trại quân, để họ không làm ô uế các trại quân của mình, là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ngự ở giữa họ."
vi.B: Dù là nam hay nữ, các ngươi phải đuổi họ ra ngoài trại quân, để họ không làm ô uế trại quân của dân mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ngự ở giữa."
vi.R: Hãy đưa cả nam lẫn nữ ra ngoài. Hãy để họ ở bên ngoài khu trại. Như vậy họ sẽ không làm cho khu trại bị ô uế, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sống ở đó giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 남자부터 여자까지 너희는 내보내라. 진 밖으로 그들을 내보내어, 내가 그 가운데 머무는 그들의 진들을 그들이 더럽히지 않게 하라."
ko.B: 남자든 여자든 내보내어 진 밖에 있게 하라. 그래야 그들이 내가 머물고 있는 백성의 진을 더럽히지 않을 것이다."
ko.R: 남자든 여자든 내보내라. 그들을 진 밖에서 지내게 해야 한다. 그러면 그들이 진을 부정하게 하지 않을 것이다. 내가 그 진 안에서 백성과 함께 살기 때문이다."

pt.L: Desde o homem até a mulher vocês [os] mandarão embora; para fora do acampamento vocês os mandarão, e não contaminarão os acampamentos deles, no meio dos quais eu habito."
pt.B: Sejam homens ou mulheres, vocês os mandarão embora e os porão fora do acampamento. Assim eles não contaminarão os acampamentos do povo no meio do qual eu habito."
pt.R: Mandem embora tanto homens como mulheres. Façam que fiquem fora do acampamento. Assim eles não vão tornar impuro o acampamento, porque eu moro ali, no meio do povo."

am.L: ከወንድ እስከ ሴት ታስወጣላችሁ፤ ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ታስወጧቸዋላችሁ፤ እኔ በመካከላቸው የማድርበትንም ሰፈራቸውን አያረክሱም።»
am.B: ወንድም ሆነ ሴት አስወጧቸው፤ ከሰፈሩ ውጭ አድርጓቸው። እንዲህ ብታደርጉ እኔ በመካከላቸው የማድርበትን የሕዝቡን ሰፈሮች አያረክሱም።»
am.R: ወንዶችንም ሴቶችንም አስወጡ። ከሰፈሩ ውጭ እንዲቆዩ አድርጉ። ያን ጊዜ ሰፈሩን አያረክሱም፤ እኔ በዚያ በመካከላቸው እኖራለሁና።»

decisions.choice: from male to female: men and women alike
decisions.reason: Naming the two ends of a range means everyone in between. No one with these kinds of uncleanness was exempt, man or woman.

decisions.choice: their camps: the camp of all Israel, made up of the camps of the tribes
decisions.reason: The plural looks at the camp as the separate camps of the tribes arranged around the tabernacle in chapter 2. All of them together form the one camp of verse 2.

decisions.choice: I dwell in their midst: the LORD lives among Israel
decisions.reason: The verb is the root of the word for the tabernacle, God's "dwelling" (Exodus 25:8-9; 29:45-46). Because the holy God lives in the camp, uncleanness there is not only a private matter; it defiles the place he lives (Leviticus 15:31; Numbers 19:13).

decisions.choice: make the camp unclean
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced say "defile". Readable uses the plainer "make unclean" and the singular "camp", since the separate tribal camps form one camp.

decisions.choice: "De l'homme jusqu'à la femme"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words are the ones used for male and female animals too, but here they name people (m1). French "mâle" and "femelle" said of people sound like animals, so even Literal says "l'homme" and "la femme" and keeps the "from ... to" shape.

decisions.choice: "남자부터 여자까지" at Literal; "남자든 여자든" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Literal keeps the Hebrew "from male to female"; the other levels say "men and women alike" in ordinary Korean.

decisions.choice: Desde o homem até a mulher (L); Sejam homens ou mulheres (B); tanto homens como mulheres (R); vocês
alternatives: Desde o macho até a fêmea (L)
decisions.reason: The pair means men and women alike (m1). Portuguese "macho" and "fêmea" are said of animals, so Literal says "homem" and "mulher". The command passes from Moses to the people, and the verbs are plural in the Hebrew, so they are "vocês" forms.

decisions.choice: "የማድርበት" (where I dwell), from "ማደር"
decisions.reason: The verb is the one behind "ማደሪያ", the terms list's word for the tabernacle, so the Amharic keeps the link between God's dwelling among Israel and his dwelling place. Readable says plainly "እኖራለሁ" (I live).

decisions.choice: the sins of humankind: wrongs that people do to one another
alternatives: any of the sins that people commit
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean the sins that human beings commit, or sins committed against a fellow human. What follows points to the second: the guilty person must repay the one who was wronged (verse 7). The law restates Leviticus 5:20-26, where a person cheats or robs a neighbor and so acts unfaithfully against the LORD.

decisions.choice: acting unfaithfully: breaking faith, a breach of trust
decisions.reason: The verb and noun describe disloyalty, taking what is not one's own or betraying a trust (Leviticus 5:15; Joshua 7:1). Wronging a neighbor is counted as unfaithfulness toward the LORD himself, who is witness to the dealings of his people. The same word describes a wife's unfaithfulness in verse 12.

decisions.choice: is guilty: has incurred guilt and must make it right
decisions.reason: The verb means to be guilty or to bear the obligation that guilt brings. It may also include the person's becoming aware of the guilt, which then leads to the confession of verse 7 (Leviticus 5:23).

decisions.choice: wrong(s) another person
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the sins of humankind" means here, following the meaning decision. Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: "commet ainsi une infidélité envers le SEIGNEUR" (B); "C'est être infidèle au SEIGNEUR" (R)
decisions.reason: The word for a breach of trust is "commettre une infidélité", as in Leviticus 5, so that the link with the wife's "infidélité" in verse 12 stays visible (m2). Readable turns it into the plain adjective "infidèle".

decisions.choice: "bất trung với" for "acting unfaithfully against" (maal)
decisions.reason: The word is a breach of trust; "bất trung" says that plainly and is used again for the wife's unfaithfulness in 5:12 and 27, where the Hebrew repeats the same word.

decisions.choice: "사람들이 짓는 죄" for "the sins of humankind" at Literal; "다른 사람에게 잘못을 저질러" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The footnoted meaning decision reads the phrase as wrongs people do to one another; the Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase and the other levels say the sense. "신의를 저버리다" is the phrase Korean Leviticus 5:15 uses for acting unfaithfully.

decisions.choice: cometendo infidelidade contra (L); for infiel a (B); ser infiel a (R)
decisions.reason: The words name a breach of trust (m2). Portuguese "infidelidade" and "infiel" keep the link with the wife's unfaithfulness in verse 12, where the same Hebrew word returns; "prevaricar" is a legal word few readers know. Balanced ends the condition with "é culpada" and lets verse 7 begin the instruction, since a Portuguese sentence of that length would lose its thread.

decisions.choice: "ታማኝነትን ማጉደል" (to break faith) for the Hebrew "act unfaithfully" (maʿal), here and in 5:12, 27
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a breach of trust (m2); "ታማኝነትን ማጉደል" says that, and keeps "በደል" for the guilt and the wrong done, which the next verses name.

source.text: וְהִתְוַדּ֗וּ אֶֽת־חַטָּאתָם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂוּ֒ וְהֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַחֲמִישִׁת֖וֹ יֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֑יו וְנָתַ֕ן לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָשַׁ֥ם לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and they shall confess their sin which they did, and he shall return his guilt [payment] in its head, and its fifth he shall add to it, and give [it] to [the one] whom he was guilty to him.

en.L: then they shall confess their sin that they have committed, and he shall repay his guilt [payment] in full, and add its fifth to it, and give [it] to the one against whom he was guilty.
en.B: they must confess their sin openly. The guilty person must pay back the full amount owed for the wrong, add a fifth to it, and hand it over to the one who was harmed.
en.R: They must admit the sin they have done. They must pay back in full what they owe for the wrong, and add one fifth more. Then they must give it to the person they wronged.

es.L: entonces confesarán el pecado que han cometido, y él restituirá [el pago de] su culpa por completo, le añadirá la quinta parte y lo dará a aquel contra quien se hizo culpable.
es.B: deberá confesar abiertamente su pecado. El culpable devolverá por completo lo que debe por el daño, le añadirá una quinta parte y se lo entregará al que fue perjudicado.
es.R: Esa persona tiene que reconocer el pecado que cometió. Tiene que pagar todo lo que debe por el daño y añadir una quinta parte más. Luego tiene que dárselo a la persona a quien hizo daño.

fr.L: alors ils confesseront le péché qu’ils ont commis, et il restituera [le prix de] sa culpabilité en totalité, il y ajoutera un cinquième, et il le donnera à celui envers qui il s’est rendu coupable.
fr.B: elle devra confesser ouvertement son péché. Le coupable rendra en totalité ce qu’il doit pour le tort commis, il y ajoutera un cinquième et le remettra à celui qui a été lésé.
fr.R: Cette personne doit reconnaître le péché qu’elle a commis. Elle doit rembourser en entier ce qu’elle doit pour le tort causé, et ajouter un cinquième en plus. Puis elle doit le donner à la personne à qui elle a fait du tort.

sw.L: basi wataungama dhambi yao waliyoifanya, naye atalipa [malipo ya] hatia yake kwa ukamilifu, na kuongeza juu yake sehemu yake ya tano, na kumpa yule aliyemkosea.
sw.B: ataungama dhambi yake waziwazi. Mwenye hatia atalipa kiasi chote anachodaiwa kwa kosa hilo, aongeze sehemu ya tano juu yake, na kumpa yule aliyedhuriwa.
sw.R: Lazima akiri dhambi aliyoifanya. Lazima alipe kikamilifu kile anachodaiwa kwa kosa hilo, na kuongeza sehemu moja ya tano zaidi. Kisha lazima ampe mtu aliyemkosea.

vi.L: thì họ phải xưng tội mình đã phạm, và người ấy phải bồi hoàn trọn vẹn [khoản] mình mắc nợ vì tội, và thêm vào một phần năm, và trao [nó] cho người mà mình đã phạm đến.
vi.B: thì phải xưng ra tội mình đã phạm. Người có tội phải bồi hoàn đủ số mình nợ vì điều sai trái, thêm một phần năm, rồi trao cho người bị thiệt hại.
vi.R: Người ấy phải nhận tội mình đã làm. Người ấy phải trả lại đầy đủ những gì mình nợ vì điều sai trái, và trả thêm một phần năm nữa. Rồi người ấy phải trao số ấy cho người mình đã làm hại.

ko.L: 그들은 자기들이 지은 죄를 자백해야 하고, 그는 자기의 죄책[의 값]을 원금대로 갚고, 거기에 오분의 일을 더하여, 자기가 죄를 지은 상대에게 주어야 한다.
ko.B: 그는 자기가 지은 죄를 털어놓고 자백해야 한다. 죄를 지은 사람은 잘못한 만큼 다 갚고, 거기에 오분의 일을 더하여 피해를 입은 사람에게 주어야 한다.
ko.R: 그는 자기가 지은 죄를 털어놓아야 한다. 그리고 잘못한 만큼 다 갚고, 오분의 일을 더 얹어야 한다. 그런 다음 그것을 자기가 잘못한 사람에게 주어야 한다.

pt.L: então confessarão o pecado que cometeram, e ele restituirá a sua culpa por inteiro, e lhe acrescentará a quinta parte, e [a] dará àquele contra quem se tornou culpado.
pt.B: Ela deverá confessar abertamente o seu pecado. O culpado restituirá por inteiro o que deve pelo mal que fez, acrescentará um quinto e entregará tudo a quem foi prejudicado.
pt.R: Ela deve admitir o pecado que cometeu. Deve pagar tudo o que deve pelo mal que fez e acrescentar mais um quinto. Depois deve entregar isso à pessoa que foi prejudicada.

am.L: የሠሩትንም ኃጢአት ይናዘዛሉ፤ የበደሉንም [ካሣ] በሙሉ ይመልሳል፤ በላዩም አንድ አምስተኛውን ይጨምራል፤ ለበደለውም ሰው ይሰጠዋል።
am.B: የሠሩትን ኃጢአት በግልጽ ይናዘዙ። በደለኛው ሰው ስለ በደሉ የሚገባውን ሙሉ ካሣ ይክፈል፤ በላዩም አንድ አምስተኛ ጨምሮ ለተበደለው ሰው ይስጠው።
am.R: የሠሩትን ኃጢአት ማመን አለባቸው። ስለ በደሉ ያለባቸውን ሙሉ በሙሉ መክፈል አለባቸው፤ በላዩም አንድ አምስተኛ መጨመር አለባቸው። ከዚያም ለበደሉት ሰው መስጠት አለባቸው።

decisions.choice: they confess ... he repays: the same guilty person
decisions.reason: The verbs move from plural ("they", the man or woman of verse 6) to singular ("he"). Both refer to whoever committed the wrong.

decisions.choice: his guilt in its head: the payment for the wrong, the full original amount
decisions.reason: The word for guilt can name the guilt itself, the guilt offering, or, as here, the payment that makes up for the wrong. "In its head" means the principal, the whole sum taken (Leviticus 5:24). The ram offered to the LORD is mentioned separately in verse 8.

decisions.choice: its fifth: an extra twenty percent
decisions.reason: The wrongdoer pays back what was taken and a fifth more, as Leviticus 5:16, 24 requires.

decisions.choice: confess: say openly what one has done
decisions.reason: Leviticus 5:20-26 does not mention confession for this wrong, though Leviticus 5:5 requires it for other sins. Here the guilty person must name the sin as well as repay it.

decisions.choice: the guilty person
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies the subject at the change from "they" to "he", so that it is clear who repays. Readable keeps "they" throughout.

decisions.choice: singular "deberá confesar" (B); "Esa persona tiene que" (R)
decisions.reason: The plural "they" of the Hebrew refers to the one man or woman of verse 6 (m1). Literal keeps "confesarán"; Balanced and Readable use the singular, which Spanish needs to keep the sentence about one person, and Readable names "esa persona".

decisions.choice: "elle" / "cette personne ... elle" for the man or woman of verse 6
decisions.reason: French has no singular "they". Balanced and Readable go on from "cette personne" in verse 6 with "elle", which covers the man or the woman (m1), as in Numbers 19. Literal keeps the Hebrew plural "ils" and then "il".

decisions.choice: singular "ataungama" (B), "akiri" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plural refers to the one man or woman of verse 6 (m1); Swahili has no gender in the verb, so Balanced and Readable use the singular throughout. Readable says "kukiri" (admit), the everyday word, for "kuungama".

decisions.choice: "xưng tội" for confess, "bồi hoàn" for repaying the guilt payment; Readable keeps the singular "người ấy" where the English Readable says "they"
decisions.reason: The words Leviticus 5:5 and 16 use in Vietnamese for the same law. Vietnamese does not use a plural pronoun for one person of either sex, and "người ấy" already covers a man or a woman.

decisions.choice: Ela (essa pessoa) ... O culpado (B); Ela ... deve (R)
decisions.reason: The plural "they" and the singular "he" both mean the guilty person (m1). Portuguese Balanced and Readable continue from "essa pessoa" in verse 6 with the singular "ela", which covers a man or a woman, where the English Readable uses a singular "they" that Portuguese has no form for. Literal keeps the Hebrew change of number. "Restituir", "um quinto" follow Leviticus 5:16, 24.

decisions.choice: "ካሣ" (compensation) for the guilt payment; "ይናዘዛሉ" (L), "ይናዘዙ" (B), "ማመን" (R) for confess
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "his guilt" is the payment that puts the wrong right (m2); Amharic names it "ካሣ", in brackets at Literal. Readable uses the everyday "ማመን" (admit) for confessing.

source.text: וְאִם־אֵ֨ין לָאִ֜ישׁ גֹּאֵ֗ל לְהָשִׁ֤יב הָאָשָׁם֙ אֵלָ֔יו הָאָשָׁ֛ם הַמּוּשָׁ֥ב לַיהוָ֖ה לַכֹּהֵ֑ן מִלְּבַ֗ד אֵ֚יל הַכִּפֻּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר־בּ֖וֹ עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And if there is not to the man a redeemer to return the guilt [payment] to him, the guilt [payment] returned [is] to Yahweh, for the priest, besides the ram of the atonements by which he makes atonement by it for him.

en.L: And if {{gender:the person|the man}} has no redeemer to whom the guilt [payment] may be repaid, the guilt [payment] that is repaid [belongs] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for the priest, besides the ram of atonement with which he makes atonement for him.
en.B: If the injured person has died and left no close relative to receive repayment, then what is repaid for the wrong goes to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which means to the priest. This is besides the ram of atonement, with which the priest makes atonement for the guilty one.
en.R: But the person who was wronged may have died and have no close relative to receive the payment. Then the payment belongs to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and is given to the priest. The guilty person must also bring a ram so that the priest can make atonement for them.

es.L: Y si {{gender:la persona|el hombre}} no tiene redentor a quien se restituya el [pago de la] culpa, el [pago de la] culpa que se restituye [pertenece] {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, para el sacerdote, además del carnero de las expiaciones con el que hará expiación por él.
es.B: Si la persona perjudicada ha muerto y no dejó ningún pariente cercano que reciba la devolución, lo que se devuelve por el daño pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, es decir, al sacerdote. Esto es además del carnero de la expiación con el que el sacerdote hará expiación por el culpable.
es.R: Pero puede que la persona a quien se hizo daño haya muerto y no tenga ningún pariente cercano que reciba el pago. Entonces el pago pertenece {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y se le da al sacerdote. El culpable también tiene que traer un carnero para que el sacerdote haga expiación por él.

fr.L: Et si {{gender:la personne|l’homme}} n’a pas de rédempteur à qui l’on puisse restituer le [prix de la] culpabilité, le [prix de la] culpabilité restitué [appartient] {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, pour le prêtre, en plus du bélier des expiations par lequel il fera l’expiation pour lui.
fr.B: Si la personne lésée est morte sans laisser de proche parent pour recevoir le remboursement, ce qui est rendu pour le tort revient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, c’est-à-dire au prêtre. Cela s’ajoute au bélier de l’expiation, avec lequel le prêtre fera l’expiation pour le coupable.
fr.R: Mais la personne à qui on a fait du tort est peut-être morte, sans proche parent pour recevoir le paiement. Alors le paiement appartient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et on le donne au prêtre. Le coupable doit aussi apporter un bélier pour que le prêtre fasse l’expiation pour lui.

sw.L: Na ikiwa mtu huyo hana mkombozi wa kulipwa [malipo ya] hatia, [malipo ya] hatia yanayolipwa [ni] ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa ajili ya kuhani, mbali na kondoo dume wa upatanisho, ambaye kwa njia yake atamfanyia upatanisho.
sw.B: Ikiwa mtu aliyedhuriwa amekufa bila kuacha ndugu wa karibu wa kupokea malipo, basi kinacholipwa kwa kosa hilo ni cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yaani, ni cha kuhani. Hiyo ni zaidi ya kondoo dume wa upatanisho, ambaye kwa njia yake kuhani atamfanyia upatanisho mwenye hatia.
sw.R: Lakini huenda mtu aliyekosewa amekufa, wala hana ndugu wa karibu wa kupokea malipo. Hapo malipo hayo ni ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nayo hupewa kuhani. Mwenye hatia lazima pia alete kondoo dume ili kuhani amfanyie upatanisho.

vi.L: Và nếu người ấy không có người chuộc để nhận [khoản] bồi hoàn, thì [khoản] bồi hoàn sẽ [thuộc] về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cho thầy tế lễ, ngoài con chiên đực chuộc tội mà thầy tế lễ dùng để chuộc tội cho người ấy.
vi.B: Nếu người bị thiệt hại đã chết mà không có bà con gần để nhận khoản bồi hoàn, thì khoản bồi hoàn ấy thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tức là thuộc về thầy tế lễ. Điều này ngoài con chiên đực chuộc tội mà thầy tế lễ dùng để chuộc tội cho người có tội.
vi.R: Nhưng người bị hại có thể đã chết và không có bà con gần để nhận khoản trả ấy. Khi đó khoản trả thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và được trao cho thầy tế lễ. Người có tội cũng phải đem đến một con chiên đực để thầy tế lễ chuộc tội cho mình.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 그 사람에게 죄책[의 값]을 돌려받을 무를 자가 없으면, 돌려주는 죄책[의 값]은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 [속하여] 제사장의 것이 될 것이니, 그를 위하여 속죄하는 데 쓰는 속죄의 숫양 외에 [그러하다].
ko.B: 피해를 입은 사람이 죽었는데 갚는 것을 받을 가까운 친척도 없으면, 잘못에 대하여 갚는 것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아가니, 곧 제사장의 것이 된다. 이것은 제사장이 죄를 지은 사람을 위하여 속죄할 때 쓰는 속죄의 숫양과는 따로이다.
ko.R: 그런데 피해를 입은 사람이 죽고, 갚는 것을 받을 가까운 친척도 없을 수 있다. 그러면 그 갚는 것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 것이 되고, 제사장에게 주어야 한다. 죄를 지은 사람은 숫양도 한 마리 가져와야 한다. 그러면 제사장이 그 숫양으로 그를 위하여 속죄할 것이다.

pt.L: E se o homem não tiver resgatador a quem se restitua a culpa, a culpa restituída [pertence] {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, ao sacerdote, além do carneiro da expiação com o qual ele faz expiação por ele.
pt.B: Se a pessoa prejudicada tiver morrido e não houver nenhum parente próximo para receber a restituição, o que se restitui pelo mal feito pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, isto é, ao sacerdote. Isso é além do carneiro da expiação, com o qual o sacerdote faz expiação pelo culpado.
pt.R: Mas pode ser que a pessoa prejudicada tenha morrido e não tenha nenhum parente próximo para receber o pagamento. Então o pagamento pertence {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e é entregue ao sacerdote. O culpado também deve trazer um carneiro, para que o sacerdote faça expiação por ele.

am.L: ለሰውዬው ግን የበደሉ [ካሣ] የሚመለስለት ቤዢ ባይኖረው፣ የሚመለሰው ካሣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ለካህኑ ይሆናል፤ ይኸውም ካህኑ ስለ እርሱ ከሚያስተሰርይበት ከማስተስረያው አውራ በግ ሌላ ነው።
am.B: የተበደለው ሰው ሞቶ ካሣውን የሚቀበል የቅርብ ዘመድ ባይተው፣ የሚመለሰው ካሣ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ይሆናል፤ ይህም ማለት ለካህኑ ይሰጣል። ይህም ካህኑ ለበደለኛው ከሚያስተሰርይበት ከማስተስረያው አውራ በግ ሌላ ነው።
am.R: ነገር ግን የተበደለው ሰው ሞቶ ካሣውን የሚቀበል የቅርብ ዘመድ ላይኖረው ይችላል። በዚያ ጊዜ ካሣው {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ይሆናል፤ ለካህኑም ይሰጣል። በደለኛው ሰው ደግሞ ካህኑ እንዲያስተሰርይለት አውራ በግ ማምጣት አለበት።

decisions.choice: a redeemer: the nearest relative who acts on behalf of a family member
decisions.reason: The redeemer was the close relative who bought back family land or a relative sold into service, and who stood up for the family's rights (Leviticus 25:25, 48-49). Here he is the one who would receive the repayment in place of the person wronged.

decisions.choice: the man: the person who was wronged
decisions.reason: "The man" is the injured party. Since a living person would receive the payment himself, the case is one where that person has died and left no relative to receive it.

decisions.choice: to the LORD, for the priest: the payment goes to the sanctuary
decisions.reason: Wrong done to a neighbor is also wrong done to the LORD (verse 6). When no human can receive the payment, it goes to the LORD, which means it is given to the priest who serves him.

decisions.choice: the ram of atonement: the guilt offering ram
decisions.reason: The ram is the guilt offering of Leviticus 5:25, by which the priest makes atonement for the wrongdoer. It is offered whether or not the payment goes to a relative; the plural "atonements" names the purpose of the ram.

decisions.choice: has died / may have died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state what the case implies, that the wronged person is no longer living. Literal leaves it implied.

decisions.choice: close relative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the redeemer is in this case, the relative who would receive the payment. Literal keeps "redeemer".

decisions.choice: "rédempteur"
alternatives: "proche parent" as at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the title of the relative who buys back and acts for the family (m1) with the ordinary French "rédempteur"; "goël" is known only to specialists. Balanced and Readable say "proche parent", as the English says "close relative".

decisions.choice: "mkombozi"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the title "mkombozi" (one who buys back) for the relative of m1; Balanced and Readable say "ndugu wa karibu", as the English says "close relative".

decisions.choice: "người ấy" for "the man", with no gender span; "người chuộc" (L) / "bà con gần" (B, R) for the redeemer
alternatives: a span such as "người đàn ông ấy"
decisions.reason: "người ấy" names the wronged person without marking sex, so Vietnamese has one wording for both of the English setting's choices. The redeemer is the nearest relative who acts for the family; Literal keeps the title, Balanced and Readable say who he is.

decisions.choice: "무를 자" (Literal) and "가까운 친척" (Balanced, Readable) for the redeemer
decisions.reason: The word Korean Leviticus 25:25 uses for the go'el at Literal; the other levels name the nearest relative, as the English does. "그 사람" covers the English gender span on "the person / the man".

decisions.choice: o homem; resgatador (L); a pessoa prejudicada; parente próximo (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal says "resgatador", the relative who buys back and stands up for a family member (m1); "redentor" in Portuguese suggests the theological title. Where the English Literal has a gender span on "the man", Portuguese Literal keeps "o homem" and Balanced and Readable already say "a pessoa prejudicada", which includes men and women, so no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: his holy things shall be his: the giver controls his gifts until they are given
alternatives: each priest keeps the holy things given to him
decisions.reason: The first "his" belongs to the giver. The second can refer to the giver, so that a person decides which priest receives the gift, or to the priest, so that each priest keeps the holy things given to him.
