am.L: «ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ እንዲህም በላቸው፦ “ሰው፣ የማንኛውም ሰው ሚስት ብትስት፣ በእርሱም ላይ ታማኝነትን ብታጎድል፣
am.B: «ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገር፤ እንዲህም በላቸው፦ “የአንድ ሰው ሚስት ከእርሱ ብትስትና ታማኝነቷን ብታጎድልበት፣
am.R: «ለእስራኤላውያን እንዲህ በላቸው፦ “የአንድ ሰው ሚስት ከባሏ ዞር ብላ ታማኝነቷን ልታጎድልበት ትችላለች።

decisions.choice: a man, a man: any man at all
decisions.reason: Saying "man" twice makes the case general: whatever husband it may be (Leviticus 15:2; 17:3).

decisions.choice: turns aside: leaves the right way, here the faithfulness owed in marriage
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn off a road (Proverbs 4:15; 7:25). In this chapter it is used of a wife who leaves her husband for another man (verses 19, 20, 29).

decisions.choice: acts unfaithfully against him: breaks the trust of the marriage
decisions.reason: This is the same word for unfaithfulness used of wronging the LORD in verse 6. Marriage is a bond of trust, and adultery breaks it.

decisions.choice: when: the start of a long case that runs to verse 15
decisions.reason: Verses 12-14 set out the situation and verse 15 gives what is to be done. The sentence carries on through several verses.

decisions.choice: Suppose
decisions.reason: Balanced opens the long case with "Suppose" so that the reader can follow the conditions in verses 12-14 before the instruction in verse 15.

decisions.choice: "la femme d'un homme, quel qu'il soit"
decisions.reason: The doubled "man, man" makes the case general (m1). French cannot repeat the noun, so Literal says "quel qu'il soit"; Balanced and Readable say simply "la femme d'un homme".

decisions.choice: "kukengeuka" (L), "kupotoka" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is turning off the right road (m2). "Kukengeuka" keeps that picture at Literal and through the chapter (verses 19, 20, 29); Balanced uses "kupotoka", going astray, here at the start of the case. Readable says plainly that she turns away from her husband.

decisions.choice: se desviar (L); se desvie (B); se afaste (R); for infiel / seja infiel
decisions.reason: The verb pictures turning off the right road (m2), which "desviar-se" keeps; "infiel" is the word of verse 6 for the same Hebrew noun (m3). The chapter's wording stays as plain and decent as the English: it names what happened without coarse or euphemistic words. Balanced opens with "Suponham", addressed to the people, as the English "Suppose" begins the long case (m4).

decisions.choice: God to Moses "አንተ" ("ተናገር", "በላቸው"); the priest to the woman "አንቺ" (5:19-22)
decisions.reason: As the terms list sets it: God speaks to one person with "አንተ", and a priest speaking to the woman before the LORD uses the plain "አንቺ", as the Hebrew's singular address.

source.text: וְשָׁכַ֨ב אִ֣ישׁ אֹתָהּ֮ שִׁכְבַת־זֶרַע֒ וְנֶעְלַם֙ מֵעֵינֵ֣י אִישָׁ֔הּ וְנִסְתְּרָ֖ה וְהִ֣יא נִטְמָ֑אָה וְעֵד֙ אֵ֣ין בָּ֔הּ וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א נִתְפָּֽשָׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: and lies a man with her [a] lying of seed, and it is hidden from [the] eyes of her husband, and she is concealed, and she has defiled herself, and [a] witness there is not against her, and she was not caught,

en.L: and a man lies with her [with] a lying of seed, and it is hidden from her husband's eyes, and she is concealed, and she has defiled herself, and there is no witness against her, and she was not caught,
en.B: and another man sleeps with her, but it is hidden from her husband; she has defiled herself in secret, there is no witness against her, and she was not caught,
en.R: Another man sleeps with her, but her husband does not know about it. She has made herself unclean in secret. No one saw it, and she was not caught.

es.L: y un hombre se acuesta con ella con emisión de semen, y esto queda oculto a los ojos de su marido, y ella permanece encubierta, y se ha contaminado, y no hay testigo contra ella, y no fue sorprendida,
es.B: y otro hombre se acuesta con ella, pero esto queda oculto a su marido; ella se ha contaminado en secreto, no hay testigo contra ella y no fue sorprendida,
es.R: Otro hombre se acuesta con ella, pero su marido no lo sabe. Ella se ha hecho impura en secreto. Nadie lo vio, y nadie la descubrió.

fr.L: et qu’un homme couche avec elle [avec] émission de semence, et que cela soit caché aux yeux de son mari, et qu’elle soit restée cachée, et qu’elle se soit rendue impure, et qu’il n’y ait pas de témoin contre elle, et qu’elle n’ait pas été prise,
fr.B: et qu’un autre homme couche avec elle, mais que la chose soit cachée à son mari ; elle s’est rendue impure en secret, il n’y a aucun témoin contre elle et elle n’a pas été prise sur le fait,
fr.R: Un autre homme couche avec elle, mais son mari n’en sait rien. Elle s’est rendue impure en secret. Personne ne l’a vue, et elle n’a pas été prise sur le fait.

sw.L: na mwanamume akalala naye kwa kumwaga shahawa, na jambo hilo likafichika machoni pa mumewe, naye akabaki amejificha, naye amejitia unajisi, na hakuna shahidi dhidi yake, wala hakukamatwa,
sw.B: na mwanamume mwingine akalala naye, lakini jambo hilo likafichika kwa mumewe; amejitia unajisi kwa siri, hakuna shahidi dhidi yake, wala hakukamatwa,
sw.R: Mwanamume mwingine analala naye, lakini mumewe hajui. Amejitia unajisi kwa siri. Hakuna aliyeona, wala hakukamatwa.

vi.L: và một người đàn ông nằm với nàng [mà] giao hợp, và việc ấy bị giấu khỏi mắt chồng nàng, và nàng giữ kín, và nàng đã làm ô uế mình, và không có nhân chứng nào chống lại nàng, và nàng không bị bắt gặp,
vi.B: và có một người đàn ông khác ăn nằm với nàng, nhưng việc ấy bị giấu kín không cho chồng nàng biết; nàng đã lén lút làm ô uế mình, không có nhân chứng nào chống lại nàng, và nàng không bị bắt quả tang,
vi.R: Một người đàn ông khác ăn nằm với cô ấy, nhưng chồng cô không biết. Cô ấy đã lén lút làm cho mình bị ô uế. Không ai thấy, và cô ấy không bị bắt quả tang.

ko.L: 어떤 남자가 씨를 [쏟는] 동침으로 그 여자와 동침하였는데, 그것이 그 여자의 남편의 눈에 숨겨지고, 그 여자가 [그 일을] 감추었으며, 그 여자가 자기를 더럽혔으나, 그 여자에게 불리한 증인이 없고, 그 여자가 붙잡히지도 않았는데,
ko.B: 다른 남자가 그 여자와 동침했는데도 남편이 그 일을 모르고, 그 여자가 몰래 자기를 더럽혔으나, 그 여자에게 불리한 증인이 없고 그 여자가 붙잡히지도 않았는데,
ko.R: 다른 남자가 그 여자와 잠자리를 같이했지만, 남편은 그 일을 모른다. 그 여자는 몰래 자기를 부정하게 했다. 본 사람도 없고, 그 여자가 붙잡히지도 않았다.

pt.L: e um homem se deitar com ela [com] emissão de sêmen, e isso for escondido dos olhos do marido dela, e ela se ocultar, e ela se contaminar, e não houver testemunha contra ela, e ela não tiver sido apanhada,
pt.B: e outro homem tenha relações com ela, mas isso fique escondido do marido; ela se contaminou em segredo, não há testemunha contra ela e ela não foi apanhada.
pt.R: Outro homem dorme com ela, mas o marido não fica sabendo. Ela se tornou impura em segredo. Ninguém viu, e ela não foi apanhada.

am.L: ሰውም ከእርሷ ጋር ዘሩን አፍስሶ ቢተኛ፣ ይህም ከባሏ ዓይን ቢሰወር፣ እርሷም ብትደበቅ፣ ራሷንም ብታረክስ፣ በእርሷም ላይ ምስክር ባይኖር፣ እርሷም ባትያዝ፣
am.B: ሌላ ሰውም ከእርሷ ጋር ቢተኛ፣ ነገር ግን ይህ ከባሏ ቢሰወር፣ በስውርም ራሷን ብታረክስ፣ በእርሷ ላይ ምስክር ባይኖርና ባትያዝ፣
am.R: ሌላ ሰው ከእርሷ ጋር ይተኛል፤ ባሏ ግን አያውቅም። በስውር ራሷን አርክሳለች። ማንም አላየም፤ እርሷም አልተያዘችም።

decisions.choice: lies with her a lying of seed: has sexual intercourse with her
decisions.reason: The phrase is a plain description of intercourse used in the laws (Leviticus 15:18; 18:20; 19:20). The man is someone other than her husband.

decisions.choice: she has defiled herself: adultery made her unclean
decisions.reason: Adultery is called defiling oneself (Leviticus 18:20). The uncleanness here is moral, not the kind removed by washing, and it is the question the rest of the chapter seeks to settle.

decisions.choice: no witness: there is no way to prove the charge
decisions.reason: The law did not allow anyone to be convicted on suspicion; a charge had to be confirmed by witnesses (Deuteronomy 17:6; 19:15). Adultery could carry the death penalty (Leviticus 20:10). With no witness, the case cannot go to a court, so it is put before the LORD.

decisions.choice: another man
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "another man" and "sleeps with" to make clear that the man is not her husband and what the phrase means. Literal keeps the Hebrew wording.

decisions.choice: the wife is "nàng" (L, B) and "cô ấy" / "cô" (R); the priest speaking to her says "ngươi" (L) and "bà" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must choose a pronoun for the woman. "nàng" is the usual third person for a woman in written narrative; Readable uses the plainer "cô ấy". The priest's oath is formal and solemn, so he addresses her with the respectful "bà" at Balanced and Readable, and with "ngươi" at Literal like the other legal speech. Used through 5:12-31.

decisions.choice: se deitar com ela [com] emissão de sêmen (L); tenha relações com ela (B); dorme com ela (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase is a plain legal description of intercourse (m1). Literal keeps its wording decently; Balanced says "ter relações", the usual written Portuguese, and Readable "dormir com", as the English Readable does. "Contaminar-se" (L, B) and "tornar-se impura" (R) follow the English "defile" and "make herself unclean" (m2).

source.text: וְעָבַ֨ר עָלָ֧יו רֽוּחַ־קִנְאָ֛ה וְקִנֵּ֥א אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְהִ֣וא נִטְמָ֑אָה אוֹ־עָבַ֨ר עָלָ֤יו רֽוּחַ־קִנְאָה֙ וְקִנֵּ֣א אֶת־אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ וְהִ֖יא לֹ֥א נִטְמָֽאָה׃

records.literal_gloss: and passes over him a spirit of jealousy and he is jealous of his wife, and she has defiled herself; or passes over him a spirit of jealousy and he is jealous of his wife, and she has not defiled herself,

en.L: and a spirit of jealousy passes over him and he is jealous of his wife, and she has defiled herself; or a spirit of jealousy passes over him and he is jealous of his wife, though she has not defiled herself,
en.B: and a fit of jealousy comes over him and he becomes jealous of his wife, and she has in fact defiled herself; or if a fit of jealousy comes over him and he becomes jealous of his wife though she has not defiled herself,
en.R: Then a strong feeling of jealousy comes over her husband, and he suspects her. Perhaps she has made herself unclean, or perhaps she has not, but he is still jealous and suspects her.

es.L: y pasa sobre él un espíritu de celos, y tiene celos de su mujer, y ella se ha contaminado; o pasa sobre él un espíritu de celos, y tiene celos de su mujer, aunque ella no se ha contaminado,
es.B: y le viene un ataque de celos y siente celos de su mujer, y ella de verdad se ha contaminado; o si le viene un ataque de celos y siente celos de su mujer aunque ella no se ha contaminado,
es.R: Entonces el marido siente unos celos muy fuertes y sospecha de ella. Tal vez ella se ha hecho impura, o tal vez no, pero él sigue celoso y sospecha de ella.

fr.L: et qu’un esprit de jalousie passe sur lui et qu’il soit jaloux de sa femme, et qu’elle se soit rendue impure ; ou qu’un esprit de jalousie passe sur lui et qu’il soit jaloux de sa femme, alors qu’elle ne s’est pas rendue impure,
fr.B: et qu’un accès de jalousie s’empare du mari et qu’il devienne jaloux de sa femme, alors qu’elle s’est vraiment rendue impure ; ou bien qu’un accès de jalousie s’empare de lui et qu’il devienne jaloux de sa femme alors qu’elle ne s’est pas rendue impure,
fr.R: Alors un fort sentiment de jalousie s’empare du mari, et il la soupçonne. Peut-être qu’elle s’est rendue impure, peut-être que non, mais il est quand même jaloux et il la soupçonne.

sw.L: na roho ya wivu ikampitia, naye akamwonea wivu mkewe, naye amejitia unajisi; au roho ya wivu ikampitia, naye akamwonea wivu mkewe, ingawa hajajitia unajisi,
sw.B: na wivu mkali ukamjia, akamwonea mkewe wivu, naye kweli amejitia unajisi; au ikiwa wivu mkali umemjia, akamwonea mkewe wivu, ingawa yeye hajajitia unajisi,
sw.R: Kisha mume anajawa na wivu mkubwa, na anamshuku mkewe. Huenda mkewe amejitia unajisi, au huenda hajajitia, lakini mume bado ana wivu na anamshuku.

vi.L: và một cơn ghen tuông đến trên người chồng, và người chồng ghen với vợ mình, và nàng đã làm ô uế mình; hoặc một cơn ghen tuông đến trên người chồng, và người chồng ghen với vợ mình, dù nàng không làm ô uế mình,
vi.B: và người chồng nổi cơn ghen với vợ mình, mà nàng quả thật đã làm ô uế mình; hoặc người chồng nổi cơn ghen với vợ mình, dù nàng không hề làm ô uế mình,
vi.R: Rồi người chồng nổi cơn ghen dữ dội và nghi ngờ vợ mình. Có thể cô ấy đã làm cho mình bị ô uế, cũng có thể không, nhưng người chồng vẫn ghen và nghi ngờ cô.

ko.L: 질투의 영이 그에게 임하여 그가 자기 아내를 질투하는데 그 여자가 자기를 더럽혔거나, 또는 질투의 영이 그에게 임하여 그가 자기 아내를 질투하나 그 여자가 자기를 더럽히지 않았으면,
ko.B: 남편이 질투심에 사로잡혀 아내를 의심하는데, 실제로 그 여자가 자기를 더럽혔거나, 또는 남편이 질투심에 사로잡혀 아내를 의심하지만 그 여자가 자기를 더럽히지 않았으면,
ko.R: 그러면 남편은 질투심에 사로잡혀 아내를 의심하게 된다. 아내가 정말로 자기를 부정하게 했을 수도 있고, 그러지 않았을 수도 있다. 그래도 남편은 질투하며 아내를 의심한다.

pt.L: e passar sobre ele um espírito de ciúme, e ele tiver ciúme da sua mulher, e ela se tiver contaminado; ou passar sobre ele um espírito de ciúme, e ele tiver ciúme da sua mulher, e ela não se tiver contaminado,
pt.B: e uma crise de ciúme venha sobre ele, e ele fique com ciúme da mulher, e ela de fato tenha se contaminado; ou se uma crise de ciúme vier sobre ele, e ele ficar com ciúme da mulher, sem que ela tenha se contaminado,
pt.R: Então um ciúme forte toma conta do marido, e ele desconfia dela. Talvez ela tenha se tornado impura, talvez não, mas ele continua com ciúme e desconfia dela.

am.L: የቅናትም መንፈስ ቢመጣበት፣ በሚስቱም ቢቀና፣ እርሷም ራሷን አርክሳ ብትሆን፤ ወይም የቅናት መንፈስ ቢመጣበት፣ በሚስቱም ቢቀና፣ እርሷ ግን ራሷን ያላረከሰች ብትሆን፣
am.B: ብርቱ ቅናትም ቢይዘውና በሚስቱ ቢቀና፣ እርሷም በእርግጥ ራሷን አርክሳ ብትሆን፤ ወይም ብርቱ ቅናት ቢይዘውና በሚስቱ ቢቀና፣ እርሷ ግን ራሷን ያላረከሰች ብትሆን፣
am.R: ከዚያም ባሏን ብርቱ ቅናት ይይዘዋል፤ ይጠረጥራታልም። ምናልባት ራሷን አርክሳ ይሆናል፤ ወይም ደግሞ አላረከሰች ይሆናል። እርሱ ግን አሁንም ይቀናል፤ ይጠረጥራታልም።

decisions.choice: a spirit of jealousy: a strong feeling of jealousy that takes hold of him
decisions.reason: "Spirit" here means a mood or passion that comes over a person, as in "a spirit of whoredom" (Hosea 4:12) or "a spirit of distress" (Isaiah 61:3). It is not a spirit being.

decisions.choice: jealous of his wife: suspicious of her faithfulness
decisions.reason: The verb describes the passion of someone who claims a relationship as his alone and fears it is betrayed (Proverbs 6:34). It is not envy. The same word is used of the LORD, who will not share his people with other gods (Exodus 20:5; 34:14).

decisions.choice: she has defiled herself, or she has not: the law covers both cases
decisions.reason: The husband's suspicion alone sets the procedure in motion, whether the wife is guilty or innocent. Only the LORD knows which is true, and the ritual leaves the answer to him (verses 27-28).

decisions.choice: a fit of jealousy
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "fit of jealousy" for "spirit of jealousy" to avoid the impression of a spirit being; Readable says "a strong feeling of jealousy". Literal keeps "spirit".

decisions.choice: but he is still jealous and suspects her
decisions.reason: Readable repeats the husband's suspicion after the second case, as the Hebrew does by repeating the whole clause.

decisions.choice: "một cơn ghen tuông" for "a spirit of jealousy" at Literal
decisions.reason: "thần" would be read as a spirit being and "tinh thần" as a state of morale; the meaning decision says it is a strong feeling that takes hold of him, which "cơn ghen" says. The same phrase in 5:30.

decisions.choice: "질투의 영" (Literal), "질투심에 사로잡혀" (Balanced, Readable); "질투" for the law's key word through 5:15-30
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is jealousy, and the meaning decision reads "spirit of jealousy" as a strong feeling that takes hold of him; Balanced and Readable add "의심하다" for "he is jealous of his wife", which in Korean means suspecting her faithfulness.

decisions.choice: um espírito de ciúme (L); uma crise de ciúme (B); um ciúme forte (R); ter ciúme de
decisions.reason: "Spirit" means a passion that takes hold of him, not a spirit being (m1), so Balanced says "crise de ciúme", as the English "fit of jealousy". "Ciúme" is the Portuguese word for the passion of someone who claims a relationship as his alone (m2), not "inveja". Readable adds "desconfia", as the English Readable "suspects".

decisions.choice: "የቅናት መንፈስ" (L); "ብርቱ ቅናት" (a strong jealousy, B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "spirit of jealousy"; Balanced and Readable say what it is, a strong feeling that takes hold of him (m1), as the English "a fit of jealousy" does.

source.text: וְהֵבִ֨יא הָאִ֣ישׁ אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ֮ אֶל־הַכֹּהֵן֒ וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־קָרְבָּנָהּ֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ עֲשִׂירִ֥ת הָאֵיפָ֖ה קֶ֣מַח שְׂעֹרִ֑ים לֹֽא־יִצֹ֨ק עָלָ֜יו שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֹֽא־יִתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה כִּֽי־מִנְחַ֤ת קְנָאֹת֙ ה֔וּא מִנְחַ֥ת זִכָּר֖וֹן מַזְכֶּ֥רֶת עָוֺֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: then shall bring the man his wife to the priest, and bring her offering for her, a tenth of the ephah of flour of barley; not he shall pour on it oil, and not put on it frankincense, for [a] grain offering of jealousies it [is], a grain offering of remembrance, bringing to remembrance iniquity.

en.L: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, a tenth of an ephah of barley flour; he shall not pour oil on it nor put frankincense on it, for a grain offering of jealousies it [is], a grain offering of remembrance, which brings iniquity to mind.
en.B: the man is to bring his wife to the priest. He must also bring the offering required for her, {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} of barley flour. He is not to pour oil on it or add frankincense, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, a grain offering of remembrance that calls guilt to mind.
en.R: The man must bring his wife to the priest. He must also bring an offering for her: {{units:about 2 quarts|a tenth of an ephah}} of barley flour. He must not put any olive oil or incense on it. This is because it is a grain offering about jealousy. It is an offering that brings a hidden wrong to mind.

es.L: entonces el hombre traerá a su mujer al sacerdote, y traerá su ofrenda por ella, la décima parte de un efa de harina de cebada; no derramará aceite sobre ella ni le pondrá incienso, porque es ofrenda de cereal de celos, ofrenda de cereal de recuerdo, que trae a la memoria la iniquidad.
es.B: el hombre llevará a su mujer al sacerdote. Llevará también la ofrenda que se requiere por ella, {{units:unos 2 litros|la décima parte de un efa}} de harina de cebada. No derramará aceite sobre ella ni le añadirá incienso, porque es una ofrenda de cereal por celos, una ofrenda de cereal de recuerdo que trae a la memoria la culpa.
es.R: El hombre tiene que llevar a su mujer al sacerdote. También tiene que llevar una ofrenda por ella: {{units:unos 2 litros|la décima parte de un efa}} de harina de cebada. No debe ponerle aceite de oliva ni incienso, porque es una ofrenda de cereal por causa de los celos. Es una ofrenda que trae a la memoria una falta escondida.

fr.L: alors l’homme amènera sa femme au prêtre, et il apportera son offrande pour elle, un dixième d’épha de farine d’orge ; il ne versera pas d’huile dessus et n’y mettra pas d’encens, car c’est une offrande végétale de jalousies, une offrande végétale de souvenir, qui rappelle la faute.
fr.B: le mari amènera sa femme au prêtre. Il apportera aussi l’offrande requise pour elle, {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième d’épha}} de farine d’orge. Il n’y versera pas d’huile et n’y ajoutera pas d’encens, car c’est une offrande végétale pour la jalousie, une offrande végétale de rappel, qui remet la faute en mémoire.
fr.R: Le mari doit amener sa femme au prêtre. Il doit aussi apporter une offrande pour elle : {{units:environ 2 litres|un dixième d’épha}} de farine d’orge. Il ne doit y mettre ni huile d’olive ni encens. En effet, c’est une offrande végétale liée à la jalousie, une offrande qui remet en mémoire une faute cachée.

sw.L: basi mume atamleta mkewe kwa kuhani, naye ataleta sadaka yake kwa ajili yake, sehemu ya kumi ya efa ya unga wa shayiri; hatamimina mafuta juu yake, wala hataweka ubani juu yake, kwa maana ni sadaka ya nafaka ya wivu, sadaka ya nafaka ya ukumbusho, inayokumbusha uovu.
sw.B: mume atamleta mkewe kwa kuhani. Pia ataleta sadaka inayotakiwa kwa ajili yake, unga wa shayiri {{units:kama lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya efa}}. Hatamimina mafuta juu yake wala kuweka ubani, kwa sababu ni sadaka ya nafaka ya wivu, sadaka ya nafaka ya ukumbusho inayoleta hatia akilini.
sw.R: Lazima mume amlete mkewe kwa kuhani. Lazima pia alete sadaka kwa ajili yake: unga wa shayiri {{units:kama lita 2|sehemu ya kumi ya efa}}. Asiweke mafuta ya zeituni wala ubani juu yake, kwa sababu ni sadaka ya nafaka inayohusu wivu. Ni sadaka inayokumbusha kosa lililofichwa.

vi.L: thì người chồng phải đem vợ mình đến thầy tế lễ, và đem lễ vật của nàng vì nàng, một phần mười ê-pha bột lúa mạch; người ấy không được rưới dầu lên đó, cũng không được đặt nhũ hương lên đó, vì đó [là] tế lễ ngũ cốc về sự ghen tuông, tế lễ ngũ cốc để ghi nhớ, nhắc lại sự gian ác.
vi.B: thì người chồng phải đem vợ mình đến thầy tế lễ. Người ấy cũng phải đem lễ vật cần dâng thay cho nàng, là {{units:khoảng 2,2 lít|một phần mười ê-pha}} bột lúa mạch. Người ấy không được rưới dầu hay thêm nhũ hương lên bột, vì đây là tế lễ ngũ cốc về sự ghen tuông, tế lễ ngũ cốc để ghi nhớ, nhắc lại tội lỗi.
vi.R: Người chồng phải đem vợ mình đến thầy tế lễ. Người ấy cũng phải đem một lễ vật cho vợ: {{units:khoảng 2,2 lít|một phần mười ê-pha}} bột lúa mạch. Người ấy không được đổ dầu ô-liu hay đặt nhũ hương lên đó. Vì đây là tế lễ ngũ cốc về sự ghen tuông. Đó là lễ vật làm cho một điều sai trái bị giấu kín được nhắc đến.

ko.L: 그 남자는 자기 아내를 제사장에게 데려가고, 그 여자를 위하여 그 여자의 제물로 보릿가루 에바 십분의 일을 가져가야 한다. 그는 그 위에 기름을 붓지 말고 그 위에 유향을 놓지 말아야 한다. 그것은 질투의 곡식 제물, 곧 기억나게 하는 곡식 제물로, 죄악을 기억나게 하는 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 남자는 자기 아내를 제사장에게 데려가야 한다. 그는 또 그 여자를 위한 제물로 보릿가루 {{units:약 2.2리터|에바 십분의 일}}를 가져가야 한다. 그 위에 기름을 붓거나 유향을 얹어서는 안 된다. 그것은 질투 때문에 바치는 곡식 제물이며, 죄를 드러내어 기억나게 하는 곡식 제물이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그 남자는 아내를 제사장에게 데려가야 한다. 그는 아내를 위한 제물도 가져가야 하는데, 그것은 보릿가루 {{units:약 2.2리터|에바 십분의 일}}이다. 그 위에 올리브기름이나 유향을 얹으면 안 된다. 그것은 질투 때문에 바치는 곡식 제물이기 때문이다. 그것은 숨겨진 잘못을 기억나게 하는 제물이다.

pt.L: então o homem trará a sua mulher ao sacerdote, e trará a oferta dela por ela, um décimo de efa de farinha de cevada; não derramará azeite sobre ela, nem porá incenso sobre ela, porque [é] uma oferta de cereal de ciúmes, uma oferta de cereal de lembrança, que traz a iniquidade à memória.
pt.B: o homem levará a sua mulher ao sacerdote. Levará também a oferta exigida por ela, {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|um décimo de efa}} de farinha de cevada. Não derramará azeite sobre ela nem porá incenso, porque é uma oferta de cereal por causa de ciúme, uma oferta de cereal de lembrança, que traz a culpa à memória.
pt.R: O homem deve levar a sua mulher ao sacerdote. Deve levar também uma oferta por ela: {{units:cerca de 2,2 litros|um décimo de efa}} de farinha de cevada. Não deve pôr nela azeite nem incenso, porque é uma oferta de cereal por causa de ciúme. É uma oferta que traz à memória um mal escondido.

am.L: ሰውዬው ሚስቱን ወደ ካህኑ ያመጣታል፤ ስለ እርሷም መባዋን፣ የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ የገብስ ዱቄት ያመጣል፤ በላዩም ዘይት አያፈስበትም፤ ነጭ ዕጣንም አያደርግበትም፤ የቅናት የእህል ቁርባን ነውና፤ በደልን የሚያሳስብ የመታሰቢያ የእህል ቁርባን ነው።
am.B: ሰውዬው ሚስቱን ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣት። ስለ እርሷም የሚገባውን መባ፣ {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ}} የገብስ ዱቄት ያምጣ። በዱቄቱ ላይ ዘይት አያፍስስበት፤ ነጭ ዕጣንም አያድርግበት፤ ይህ ስለ ቅናት የሚቀርብ የእህል ቁርባን፣ በደልን የሚያሳስብ የመታሰቢያ የእህል ቁርባን ነውና።
am.R: ሰውዬው ሚስቱን ወደ ካህኑ ማምጣት አለበት። ስለ እርሷም መባ፣ {{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ}} የገብስ ዱቄት ማምጣት አለበት። በዱቄቱ ላይ ዘይትም ሆነ ዕጣን ማድረግ የለበትም። ይህ ስለ ቅናት የሚቀርብ የእህል ቁርባን ነውና። የተደበቀን በደል የሚያስታውስ መባ ነው።

decisions.choice: barley flour, with no oil or frankincense: a plain offering, not a joyful one
decisions.reason: Ordinary grain offerings were of fine wheat flour with oil and frankincense (Leviticus 2:1). Barley was the cheaper grain. Like the sin offering of the poor (Leviticus 5:11), this offering has no oil or frankincense, because it is brought over a suspected wrong.

decisions.choice: a grain offering of jealousies: an offering brought because of jealousy
decisions.reason: The plural "jealousies" names the matter the offering concerns: the husband's jealousy and the question it raises (also verses 18, 25, 29).

decisions.choice: a grain offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to remembrance: it puts the matter of guilt before the LORD
decisions.reason: The offering "reminds" in the sense of calling the case to the LORD's attention so that he may act on it. Elsewhere bringing iniquity to remembrance means exposing guilt that is there (1 Kings 17:18; Ezekiel 29:16). If there is no guilt, nothing is found (verse 28).

decisions.choice: her offering for her: brought by the husband on her behalf
decisions.reason: The husband provides the offering, but it is offered for the wife, since her case is the one to be decided.

decisions.choice: about 2 quarts
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the modern measure, with "a tenth of an ephah" as the alternative. Literal keeps the Hebrew unit.

decisions.choice: incense / a hidden wrong
decisions.reason: Readable uses "incense" for frankincense, a sweet-smelling resin burned with offerings, and "a hidden wrong" for iniquity, since the case is one where any guilt is secret (verse 13).

decisions.choice: "une offrande végétale de souvenir, qui rappelle la faute" (L); "une offrande végétale de rappel, qui remet la faute en mémoire" (B)
decisions.reason: The offering "reminds" in the sense of putting the case before the LORD (m3). Literal keeps the noun "souvenir"; Balanced says "rappel" and "remettre en mémoire", which say more plainly that the offering brings the matter forward.

decisions.choice: "khoảng 2,2 lít" with "một phần mười ê-pha" as the units alternative
alternatives: US units as in the English
decisions.reason: Metric by default (ephah 22 litres), as in Leviticus; the setting gives the original measure, which Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: {{units:약 2.2리터|에바 십분의 일}}, metric by default
alternatives: about 2 quarts as in the English
decisions.reason: As Korean Leviticus 5:11: the Pentateuch sheets set a tenth of an ephah at 2.2 litres; the Literal keeps the ephah, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "곡식 제물" for the grain offering
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word; "소제" is the older Sino-Korean name.

decisions.choice: cerca de 2,2 litros, alternative "um décimo de efa"
decisions.reason: As in Leviticus 5:11: the metric measure by default, with the Hebrew unit as the alternative, where the English converts to quarts. Literal keeps "efa".

decisions.choice: oferta de cereal de ciúmes (L); oferta de cereal por causa de ciúme (B, R); de lembrança / traz ... à memória
decisions.reason: "Oferta de cereal" is the Leviticus 2 name. Literal keeps the plural "ciúmes"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, an offering brought because of jealousy (m2). "Lembrança" and "trazer à memória" keep the Hebrew link between the two words of m3, as "porção memorial" does in verse 26.

decisions.choice: "{{units:2.2 ሊትር ያህል|የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ}}": metric by default, the Hebrew measure as the alternative; Literal keeps "የኢፍ አንድ አሥረኛ"
decisions.reason: Amharic gives metric measures with the Hebrew unit as the alternative (the terms list); a tenth of an ephah is about 2.2 litres, as in Exodus 29:40.

decisions.choice: "የእህል ቁርባን" (grain offering); "የመታሰቢያ" (of remembrance); "ነጭ ዕጣን" (frankincense, L, B), "ዕጣን" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms list's and Leviticus 2's words. Readable says "ዕጣን" for the English Readable's "incense".

source.text: וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖הּ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהֶֽעֱמִדָ֖הּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And shall bring her near the priest and make her stand before Yahweh.

en.L: And the priest shall bring her near and make her stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The priest is to bring her near and set her in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The priest must bring her forward and have her stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at the tabernacle.

es.L: Y el sacerdote la hará acercarse y la hará estar en pie delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: El sacerdote la hará acercarse y la pondrá delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que hacerla pasar adelante y ponerla de pie delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en el tabernáculo.

fr.L: Et le prêtre la fera approcher et la fera se tenir devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le prêtre la fera approcher et la placera devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit la faire avancer et la faire se tenir devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à la Demeure.

sw.L: Na kuhani atamleta karibu, na kumsimamisha mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kuhani atamleta karibu na kumsimamisha mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lazima kuhani amlete mbele na kumsimamisha mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika maskani.

vi.L: Và thầy tế lễ sẽ đem nàng đến gần và cho nàng đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ phải đem nàng đến gần và để nàng đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ phải đưa người vợ đến và cho cô đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Đền Tạm.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장은 그 여자를 가까이 데려와 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 세워야 한다.
ko.B: 제사장은 그 여자를 가까이 데려와 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 세워야 한다.
ko.R: 제사장은 그 여자를 앞으로 데려와 성막에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 서게 해야 한다.

pt.L: E o sacerdote a fará aproximar-se e a fará ficar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: O sacerdote a fará aproximar-se e a colocará diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: O sacerdote deve levá-la para a frente e fazer que ela fique diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, no tabernáculo.

am.L: ካህኑም ያቀርባታል፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊትም ያቆማታል።
am.B: ካህኑ ያቅርባት፤ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊትም ያቁማት።
am.R: ካህኑ ወደ ፊት አምጥቷት በማደሪያው ድንኳን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ማቆም አለበት።

decisions.choice: before the LORD: at the sanctuary, in his presence
decisions.reason: To stand before the LORD is to be brought to the sanctuary, in the courtyard near the altar (verse 25), where cases too hard for people were laid before him (Exodus 22:7-8).

decisions.choice: at the tabernacle
decisions.reason: Readable says where she stands "before the LORD", at the tabernacle. Literal and Balanced keep the phrase as it is.

source.text: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מַ֥יִם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים בִּכְלִי־חָ֑רֶשׂ וּמִן־הֶֽעָפָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה֙ בְּקַרְקַ֣ע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִקַּ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנָתַ֥ן אֶל־הַמָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And shall take the priest holy water in a vessel of clay, and from the dust which is on [the] floor of the tabernacle shall take the priest and put into the water.

en.L: And the priest shall take holy water in a vessel of clay, and some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take and put into the water.
en.B: Then the priest is to put holy water in a clay pot, take some of the dust that lies on the tabernacle floor, and add it to the water.
en.R: Then the priest must pour some holy water into a jar made of clay. He must take some dust from the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

es.L: Y el sacerdote tomará agua santa en una vasija de barro, y del polvo que haya en el suelo del tabernáculo tomará el sacerdote y [lo] echará en el agua.
es.B: Luego el sacerdote pondrá agua santa en una olla de barro, tomará un poco del polvo que hay en el suelo del tabernáculo y lo echará en el agua.
es.R: Luego el sacerdote tiene que echar un poco de agua santa en un jarro de barro. Tiene que tomar un poco de polvo del suelo del tabernáculo y echarlo en el agua.

fr.L: Et le prêtre prendra de l’eau sainte dans un vase de terre, et de la poussière qui sera sur le sol de la Demeure, le prêtre [en] prendra et [la] mettra dans l’eau.
fr.B: Puis le prêtre mettra de l’eau sainte dans un pot de terre, prendra un peu de la poussière qui se trouve sur le sol de la Demeure et la mettra dans l’eau.
fr.R: Puis le prêtre doit verser un peu d’eau sainte dans une cruche en terre. Il doit prendre un peu de poussière sur le sol de la Demeure et la mettre dans l’eau.

sw.L: Na kuhani atachukua maji matakatifu katika chombo cha udongo, na sehemu ya mavumbi yaliyo juu ya sakafu ya maskani kuhani atachukua na kuyatia ndani ya maji.
sw.B: Kisha kuhani atatia maji matakatifu katika chungu cha udongo, achukue sehemu ya mavumbi yaliyo sakafuni mwa maskani, na kuyatia ndani ya maji.
sw.R: Kisha lazima kuhani amimine maji matakatifu katika mtungi wa udongo. Lazima achukue mavumbi kidogo kutoka sakafu ya maskani na kuyatia ndani ya maji.

vi.L: Và thầy tế lễ sẽ lấy nước thánh trong một cái bình bằng đất, và thầy tế lễ sẽ lấy một ít bụi trên nền Đền Tạm và bỏ vào nước.
vi.B: Rồi thầy tế lễ phải đổ nước thánh vào một cái bình bằng đất, lấy một ít bụi trên nền Đền Tạm và bỏ vào nước.
vi.R: Rồi thầy tế lễ phải đổ một ít nước thánh vào một cái bình bằng đất sét. Ông phải lấy một ít bụi trên nền Đền Tạm và bỏ vào nước.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장은 토기에 거룩한 물을 담고, 성막 바닥에 있는 흙을 제사장이 조금 집어 그 물에 넣어야 한다.
ko.B: 그다음에 제사장은 토기 그릇에 거룩한 물을 담고, 성막 바닥의 흙을 조금 집어 그 물에 넣어야 한다.
ko.R: 그다음에 제사장은 흙으로 빚은 그릇에 거룩한 물을 조금 부어야 한다. 그리고 성막 바닥에서 흙을 조금 집어 그 물에 넣어야 한다.

pt.L: E o sacerdote tomará água santa num vaso de barro, e do pó que houver no chão do tabernáculo o sacerdote tomará e [o] porá na água.
pt.B: Depois o sacerdote porá água santa num vaso de barro, pegará um pouco do pó que está no chão do tabernáculo e o porá na água.
pt.R: Então o sacerdote deve pôr um pouco de água santa num pote de barro. Deve pegar um pouco de pó do chão do tabernáculo e pôr na água.

am.L: ካህኑም በሸክላ ዕቃ የተቀደሰ ውኃ ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም በማደሪያው ወለል ላይ ካለው ትቢያ ወስዶ በውኃው ውስጥ ይጨምረዋል።
am.B: ከዚያም ካህኑ የተቀደሰ ውኃ በሸክላ ዕቃ ያድርግ፤ በማደሪያውም ወለል ላይ ካለው ትቢያ ወስዶ በውኃው ውስጥ ይጨምር።
am.R: ከዚያም ካህኑ ከሸክላ በተሠራ ማሰሮ ውስጥ የተቀደሰ ውኃ ማድረግ አለበት። ከማደሪያው ድንኳን ወለልም ትቢያ ወስዶ በውኃው ውስጥ መጨመር አለበት።

decisions.choice: holy water: water set apart for use at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The phrase occurs only here. The water may be from the bronze basin at the tabernacle, where the priests washed (Exodus 30:18-21), but the text does not say.

decisions.choice: dust from the floor of the tabernacle: earth from the holy place itself
decisions.reason: The dust comes from the ground of the sanctuary, where the LORD dwells. The water the woman drinks is ordinary water mixed with dust and, later, ink (verse 23); its power comes from the LORD, not from what is in it (verse 21).

decisions.choice: an earthen vessel: a common clay pot
decisions.reason: Clay pots were the everyday containers of the time. The plain vessel suits the plain offering of verse 15.

source.text: וְהֶעֱמִ֨יד הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת־הָאִשָּׁה֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וּפָרַע֙ אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וְנָתַ֣ן עַל־כַּפֶּ֗יהָ אֵ֚ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַזִּכָּר֔וֹן מִנְחַ֥ת קְנָאֹ֖ת הִ֑וא וּבְיַ֤ד הַכֹּהֵן֙ יִהְי֔וּ מֵ֥י הַמָּרִ֖ים הַמְאָֽרֲרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And shall make stand the priest the woman before Yahweh, and let loose the head of the woman, and put on her palms the grain offering of the remembrance, [a] grain offering of jealousies it [is], and in [the] hand of the priest shall be the waters of the bitter [things] that bring the curse.

en.L: And the priest shall set the woman before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and loosen [the hair of] the woman's head, and put on her palms the grain offering of remembrance — it [is] the grain offering of jealousy — and in the priest's hand shall be the waters of bitterness that bring the curse.
en.B: The priest is to set the woman before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, let down her hair, and put the grain offering of remembrance, the grain offering for jealousy, into her hands. In his own hand the priest is to hold the bitter water that carries the curse.
en.R: The priest must have the woman stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He must loosen her hair and put the grain offering in her hands. It is the offering about jealousy that brings the matter to mind. The priest himself must hold the bitter water that carries the curse.

es.L: Y el sacerdote pondrá a la mujer delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y soltará [el cabello de] la cabeza de la mujer, y pondrá en las palmas de sus manos la ofrenda de cereal del recuerdo —es la ofrenda de cereal de los celos—, y en la mano del sacerdote estarán las aguas de amargura que traen la maldición.
es.B: El sacerdote pondrá a la mujer delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, le soltará el cabello y le pondrá en las manos la ofrenda de cereal del recuerdo, la ofrenda de cereal por celos. En su propia mano el sacerdote tendrá el agua amarga que trae la maldición.
es.R: El sacerdote tiene que hacer que la mujer se ponga de pie delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Tiene que soltarle el cabello y ponerle en las manos la ofrenda de cereal. Es la ofrenda por causa de los celos, que trae el asunto a la memoria. El sacerdote mismo tiene que sostener el agua amarga que trae la maldición.

fr.L: Et le prêtre placera la femme devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, il dénouera [les cheveux de] la tête de la femme, et il mettra sur ses paumes l’offrande végétale de souvenir — c’est l’offrande végétale de jalousie — et dans la main du prêtre seront les eaux d’amertume qui apportent la malédiction.
fr.B: Le prêtre placera la femme devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, lui dénouera les cheveux et lui mettra dans les mains l’offrande végétale de rappel, l’offrande végétale pour la jalousie. Le prêtre tiendra dans sa propre main l’eau amère qui porte la malédiction.
fr.R: Le prêtre doit faire tenir la femme debout devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il doit lui détacher les cheveux et lui mettre l’offrande végétale dans les mains. C’est l’offrande liée à la jalousie, qui remet l’affaire en mémoire. Le prêtre lui-même doit tenir l’eau amère qui porte la malédiction.

sw.L: Na kuhani atamsimamisha mwanamke mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kuzifungua [nywele za] kichwa cha mwanamke, na kuweka viganjani mwake sadaka ya nafaka ya ukumbusho — ndiyo sadaka ya nafaka ya wivu — na mkononi mwa kuhani yatakuwa maji ya uchungu yaletayo laana.
sw.B: Kuhani atamsimamisha mwanamke mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, azifungue nywele zake, na kumwekea mikononi sadaka ya nafaka ya ukumbusho, yaani, sadaka ya nafaka ya wivu. Kuhani mwenyewe atashika mkononi maji machungu yaletayo laana.
sw.R: Lazima kuhani amsimamishe mwanamke mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Lazima aziachilie nywele zake na kumwekea mikononi sadaka ya nafaka. Ni sadaka inayohusu wivu, inayokumbusha jambo hilo. Kuhani mwenyewe lazima ashike maji machungu yaletayo laana.

vi.L: Và thầy tế lễ sẽ cho người đàn bà đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và xõa [tóc trên] đầu người đàn bà, và đặt trên lòng bàn tay nàng tế lễ ngũ cốc để ghi nhớ — đó [là] tế lễ ngũ cốc về sự ghen tuông — và trong tay thầy tế lễ sẽ có nước đắng mang lời nguyền rủa.
vi.B: Thầy tế lễ phải cho người đàn bà đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xõa tóc nàng ra, và đặt vào tay nàng tế lễ ngũ cốc để ghi nhớ, tức là tế lễ ngũ cốc về sự ghen tuông. Chính tay thầy tế lễ phải cầm nước đắng mang lời nguyền rủa.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ phải cho người vợ đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông phải xõa tóc cô ra và đặt tế lễ ngũ cốc vào tay cô. Đó là lễ vật về sự ghen tuông, làm cho sự việc được nhắc đến. Chính thầy tế lễ phải cầm nước đắng mang lời nguyền rủa.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장은 그 여자를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 세우고, 그 여자의 머리를 풀고, 기억나게 하는 곡식 제물, 곧 질투의 곡식 제물을 그 여자의 두 손바닥에 놓아야 한다. 그리고 제사장의 손에는 저주를 가져오는 쓰라림의 물이 있어야 한다.
ko.B: 제사장은 그 여자를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 세우고, 그 여자의 머리를 풀게 한 다음, 기억나게 하는 곡식 제물, 곧 질투 때문에 바치는 곡식 제물을 그 여자의 두 손에 들려야 한다. 제사장은 자기 손에 저주를 가져오는 쓴 물을 들고 있어야 한다.
ko.R: 제사장은 그 여자를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 서게 해야 한다. 그리고 그 여자의 머리를 풀고, 곡식 제물을 그 여자의 손에 들려 주어야 한다. 그것은 질투 때문에 바치는 제물로, 그 일을 기억나게 하는 제물이다. 제사장은 저주를 가져오는 쓴 물을 직접 들고 있어야 한다.

pt.L: E o sacerdote fará a mulher ficar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e soltará [os cabelos da] cabeça da mulher, e porá sobre as palmas das mãos dela a oferta de cereal de lembrança — ela [é] a oferta de cereal de ciúmes —, e na mão do sacerdote estarão as águas de amargura que trazem a maldição.
pt.B: O sacerdote colocará a mulher diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, soltará os cabelos dela e porá nas mãos dela a oferta de cereal de lembrança, a oferta de cereal por causa de ciúme. Na sua própria mão o sacerdote segurará a água amarga que traz a maldição.
pt.R: O sacerdote deve fazer a mulher ficar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Deve soltar os cabelos dela e pôr a oferta de cereal nas mãos dela. É a oferta por causa de ciúme, que traz o caso à memória. O próprio sacerdote deve segurar a água amarga que traz a maldição.

am.L: ካህኑም ሴቲቱን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ያቆማታል፤ የሴቲቱንም ራስ [ጠጉር] ይፈታል፤ የመታሰቢያውንም የእህል ቁርባን በመዳፎቿ ላይ ያደርጋል፤ እርሱም የቅናት የእህል ቁርባን ነው፤ በካህኑም እጅ እርግማን የሚያመጣው መራራው ውኃ ይሆናል።
am.B: ካህኑ ሴቲቱን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ያቁማት፤ ጠጉሯንም ይፍታ፤ የመታሰቢያውን የእህል ቁርባን፣ ስለ ቅናት የቀረበውን የእህል ቁርባን፣ በእጆቿ ላይ ያድርግ። ካህኑ ራሱ ደግሞ እርግማን የሚያመጣውን መራራ ውኃ በእጁ ይያዝ።
am.R: ካህኑ ሴቲቱን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ማቆም አለበት። ጠጉሯን ፈትቶ የእህል ቁርባኑን በእጆቿ ላይ ማድረግ አለበት። ይህ ስለ ቅናት የሚቀርበውና ጉዳዩን የሚያስታውሰው መባ ነው። ካህኑ ራሱ ደግሞ እርግማን የሚያመጣውን መራራ ውኃ መያዝ አለበት።

decisions.choice: let loose the head: let her hair hang loose, unbound
decisions.reason: The verb means to let go or let hang free. Of the head it means letting the hair down, or perhaps uncovering it, a sign of mourning or disgrace (Leviticus 10:6; 13:45; 21:10). Here it marks her as a woman under suspicion.

decisions.choice: the water of bitterness that brings the curse: water that causes bitter suffering if she is guilty
decisions.reason: "Bitterness" refers to the bitter pain the water brings on a guilty woman (verses 24, 27), and the second word means "bringing a curse", from the verb "to curse". The water is not said to taste bitter; its name describes what it does.

decisions.choice: she holds the offering, the priest holds the water
decisions.reason: The woman holds the offering that brings her case before the LORD, and the priest holds the water that will decide it, until the offering is presented (verses 25-26).

decisions.choice: the bitter water
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable shorten "the water of bitterness" to "the bitter water", the natural English form, here and through the chapter. Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: "les eaux d'amertume qui apportent la malédiction" (L); "l'eau amère qui porte la malédiction" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The name says what the water does, not how it tastes (m2). "Qui porte la malédiction" keeps the second word as a phrase, and the same wording is used through the chapter (verses 19, 22, 24, 27).

decisions.choice: "maji ya uchungu yaletayo laana" (L); "maji machungu yaletayo laana" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the noun "uchungu" (bitterness), which in Swahili also means pain, as the Hebrew word does here (m2). Balanced and Readable use the adjective "machungu". The same wording is kept through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "nước đắng mang lời nguyền rủa" at every level
decisions.reason: "đắng" keeps the Hebrew word for bitterness, and "mang lời nguyền rủa" says that the water carries the curse spoken over it. Kept the same through the chapter so the reader follows one object.

decisions.choice: "쓰라림의 물" (Literal) and "쓴 물" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is "the waters of the bitter things"; the Literal keeps the abstract noun, the other levels use the ordinary phrase, as the English does. The water causes bitter suffering if she is guilty, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: as águas de amargura que trazem a maldição (L); a água amarga que traz a maldição (B, R)
alternatives: a água da amargura que acarreta maldição
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the name of the water, said the same way through the chapter. Literal keeps the Hebrew plural and "amargura"; Balanced and Readable say "a água amarga", as the English "the bitter water". The name describes what the water does to a guilty woman, not its taste (m2), which "que traz a maldição" makes plain.

decisions.choice: soltará [os cabelos da] cabeça (L); soltará os cabelos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb means letting the hair hang loose (m1), as Leviticus 10:6 says it in Portuguese; "descobrir a cabeça", the other reading m1 names, is left to the meaning note.

decisions.choice: "እርግማን የሚያመጣው መራራ ውኃ" (the bitter water that brings the curse) at every level, through 5:27
decisions.reason: One wording for the repeated phrase, so the reader follows the water through the rite; Literal keeps the definite "መራራው ውኃ" where the Hebrew has "the waters".

records.literal_gloss: And shall make her swear the priest and say to the woman: if not has lain a man with you, and if not you have turned aside [to] uncleanness under your husband, be free from [the] waters of the bitter [things] that bring the curse, these.

en.L: And the priest shall make her swear and say to the woman, "If a man has not lain with you, and if you have not turned aside [into] uncleanness under your husband, be free from the waters of bitterness, these that bring the curse.
en.B: Then the priest is to put her under oath and say to her, "If no man but your husband has slept with you, and you have not turned aside to uncleanness while you are bound to him, you will be free from the harm of this bitter water that carries the curse.
en.R: Then the priest must make her take an oath. He must say to her, "If no other man has slept with you, and you have not been unfaithful to your husband and made yourself unclean, then this bitter water that carries the curse will not harm you.

es.L: Y el sacerdote la hará jurar y dirá a la mujer: ‘Si ningún hombre se ha acostado contigo, y si no te has desviado [hacia] la impureza estando bajo [la autoridad de] tu marido, queda libre de estas aguas de amargura que traen la maldición.
es.B: Entonces el sacerdote le tomará juramento y le dirá: ‘Si ningún otro hombre aparte de tu marido se ha acostado contigo, y no te has desviado hacia la impureza mientras estás unida a él, quedarás libre del daño de esta agua amarga que trae la maldición.
es.R: Luego el sacerdote tiene que hacer que la mujer haga un juramento. Tiene que decirle: ‘Si ningún otro hombre se ha acostado contigo, y no has sido infiel a tu marido haciéndote impura, entonces esta agua amarga que trae la maldición no te hará daño.

fr.L: Et le prêtre la fera jurer et dira à la femme : ‘Si aucun homme n’a couché avec toi, et si tu ne t’es pas détournée [vers] l’impureté alors que tu étais sous [l’autorité de] ton mari, sois indemne de ces eaux d’amertume qui apportent la malédiction.
fr.B: Puis le prêtre fera prêter serment à la femme et lui dira : ‘Si aucun homme autre que ton mari n’a couché avec toi, et si tu ne t’es pas détournée vers l’impureté alors que tu es liée à lui, cette eau amère qui porte la malédiction ne te fera aucun mal.
fr.R: Ensuite, le prêtre doit faire prêter serment à la femme. Il doit lui dire : ‘Si aucun autre homme n’a couché avec toi, et si tu n’as pas été infidèle à ton mari en te rendant impure, alors cette eau amère qui porte la malédiction ne te fera pas de mal.

sw.L: Na kuhani atamwapisha, na kumwambia mwanamke, "Ikiwa hakuna mwanamume aliyelala nawe, na ikiwa hukukengeuka [kuingia] katika unajisi ukiwa chini ya mumeo, uwe huru na maji haya ya uchungu yaletayo laana.
sw.B: Kisha kuhani atamwapisha mwanamke na kumwambia, "Ikiwa hakuna mwanamume mwingine ila mumeo aliyelala nawe, na hukukengeuka kuingia katika unajisi ukiwa umefungwa kwake, hutadhuriwa na maji haya machungu yaletayo laana.
sw.R: Kisha lazima kuhani amwapishe mwanamke. Lazima amwambie, "Ikiwa hakuna mwanamume mwingine aliyelala nawe, na hukukosa uaminifu kwa mumeo na kujitia unajisi, basi maji haya machungu yaletayo laana hayatakudhuru.

vi.L: Và thầy tế lễ sẽ bắt nàng thề và nói với người đàn bà: "Nếu không có người đàn ông nào nằm với ngươi, và nếu ngươi không lầm đường [mà sa vào] sự ô uế trong khi thuộc quyền chồng ngươi, thì ngươi sẽ khỏi bị hại bởi nước đắng mang lời nguyền rủa này.
vi.B: Rồi thầy tế lễ phải bắt nàng thề và nói với nàng: "Nếu ngoài chồng bà ra không có người đàn ông nào ăn nằm với bà, và bà không lầm đường sa vào sự ô uế trong khi đang thuộc về chồng mình, thì bà sẽ không bị nước đắng mang lời nguyền rủa này làm hại.
vi.R: Rồi thầy tế lễ phải bắt cô thề. Ông phải nói với cô: "Nếu không có người đàn ông nào khác ăn nằm với bà, và bà không bất trung với chồng để làm mình bị ô uế, thì nước đắng mang lời nguyền rủa này sẽ không làm hại bà.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장은 그 여자에게 맹세하게 하고, 그 여자에게 말해야 한다. "어떤 남자도 너와 동침하지 않았고, 네가 네 남편 아래 있으면서 곁길로 나가 부정한 일을 하지 않았으면, 저주를 가져오는 이 쓰라림의 물에서 너는 해를 면할 것이다.
ko.B: 그다음에 제사장은 그 여자에게 맹세하게 하고 이렇게 말해야 한다. "네 남편 말고 다른 남자가 너와 동침한 적이 없고, 네가 남편에게 매인 몸으로 곁길로 나가 부정한 일을 하지 않았다면, 저주를 가져오는 이 쓴 물이 너를 해치지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 그다음에 제사장은 그 여자에게 맹세하게 해야 한다. 그리고 이렇게 말해야 한다. "다른 남자가 너와 잠자리를 같이한 적이 없고, 네가 남편을 배신하여 네 몸을 부정하게 하지 않았다면, 저주를 가져오는 이 쓴 물이 너를 해치지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: E o sacerdote a fará jurar e dirá à mulher: "Se nenhum homem se deitou com você, e se você não se desviou [para a] impureza, estando sob o seu marido, fique livre destas águas de amargura que trazem a maldição.
pt.B: Depois o sacerdote a fará prestar juramento e lhe dirá: "Se nenhum homem além do seu marido teve relações com você, e se você não se desviou para a impureza enquanto estava ligada a ele, você ficará livre do mal desta água amarga que traz a maldição.
pt.R: Então o sacerdote deve fazer a mulher prestar um juramento. Ele deve dizer a ela: "Se nenhum outro homem dormiu com você, e se você não foi infiel ao seu marido nem se tornou impura, então esta água amarga que traz a maldição não vai lhe fazer mal.

am.L: ካህኑም ያስምላታል፤ ሴቲቱንም እንዲህ ይላታል፦ ‘ሰው ከአንቺ ጋር ካልተኛ፣ ከባልሽም በታች ሆነሽ ወደ ርኩሰት ካልሳትሽ፣ እርግማን ከሚያመጣው ከዚህ መራራ ውኃ ነጻ ሁኚ።
am.B: ከዚያም ካህኑ ያስምላት፤ እንዲህም ይበላት፦ ‘ከባልሽ በቀር ሌላ ሰው ከአንቺ ጋር ካልተኛ፣ ለባልሽ ታስረሽ ሳለሽ ወደ ርኩሰት ካልሳትሽ፣ እርግማን ከሚያመጣው ከዚህ መራራ ውኃ ጉዳት ነጻ ትሆኛለሽ።
am.R: ከዚያም ካህኑ ሴቲቱን ማስማል አለበት። እንዲህም ይላታል፦ ‘ሌላ ሰው ከአንቺ ጋር ካልተኛና ለባልሽ ታማኝነትሽን አጉድለሽ ራስሽን ካላረከስሽ፣ ይህ እርግማን የሚያመጣው መራራ ውኃ አይጎዳሽም።

decisions.choice: under your husband: while you are bound to your husband in marriage
decisions.reason: A wife was said to be "under" her husband, under his authority and in his household (Ezekiel 23:5). The phrase does not refer to anything before the marriage.

decisions.choice: be free: be unharmed, cleared of the charge
decisions.reason: The verb means to be free from guilt or punishment (Exodus 21:19; Numbers 5:28, 31). Spoken by the priest, it declares that the water will do the innocent woman no harm.

decisions.choice: if not ...: the oath is spoken as a condition
decisions.reason: The priest speaks the oath, and the woman takes it on herself by answering "Amen" (verse 22). The first half deals with an innocent woman, the second (verses 20-21) with a guilty one.

decisions.choice: no other man / no man but your husband
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "other", since the man meant is anyone except her husband (verse 20). Literal keeps "no man".

decisions.choice: "bajo [la autoridad de] tu marido"
decisions.reason: The phrase means while bound to her husband in marriage (m1). Bare "bajo tu marido" would be misread, so Literal brackets "la autoridad de"; Balanced says "unida a él".

decisions.choice: "sous [l'autorité de] ton mari"
decisions.reason: The phrase means while bound to her husband in marriage (m1). Bare "sous ton mari" would be read sexually in French, so Literal brackets "l'autorité de"; Balanced says "liée à lui".

decisions.choice: "trong khi thuộc quyền chồng ngươi" for "under your husband" at Literal
decisions.reason: A word-for-word "dưới chồng" would be read physically; "thuộc quyền chồng" keeps the picture of being under the husband's authority in marriage, which the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: The priest speaks to the woman in 해라체 with "너"
decisions.reason: The priest pronounces a set oath in God's name, in the same plain style as the law around it; a polite style would make the words his own conversation rather than the formula of the rite. A reviewer may prefer a softer level here.

decisions.choice: "네 남편 아래 있으면서" at Literal; "남편에게 매인 몸으로" at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Literal keeps the Hebrew "under your husband"; Balanced says the sense, bound to him in marriage.

decisions.choice: você (the priest to the woman)
decisions.reason: The priest speaks to the woman as one person to another, so Portuguese uses "você" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); "tu" is kept for God's address and for speech to God. The oath stays plain and sober at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "ከባልሽ በታች ሆነሽ" (L), "ለባልሽ ታስረሽ ሳለሽ" (B) for "under your husband"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's "under"; Balanced says what it means, while she is bound to her husband in marriage (m1).

records.literal_gloss: But you, if you have turned aside under your husband, and if you have defiled yourself, and given [a] man in you his lying, apart from your husband —

en.L: But you, if you have turned aside under your husband, and if you have defiled yourself, and a man has had his lying with you, apart from your husband —"
en.B: But if you have turned aside while bound to your husband, if you have defiled yourself and someone besides your husband has slept with you —"

vi.L: Nhưng ngươi, nếu ngươi đã lầm đường trong khi thuộc quyền chồng ngươi, và nếu ngươi đã làm ô uế mình, và một người đàn ông ngoài chồng ngươi đã nằm với ngươi —"

ko.L: 그러나 너, 만일 네가 네 남편 아래 있으면서 곁길로 나갔고, 만일 네가 네 몸을 더럽혀서, 네 남편 외에 어떤 남자가 너와 동침하였으면—"

pt.R: Mas pode ser que você tenha sido infiel enquanto estava casada com o seu marido. Pode ser que você tenha se tornado impura dormindo com outro homem que não é o seu marido."

decisions.choice: but you, if ...: the sentence breaks off and resumes in verse 21
decisions.reason: The priest's words stop after the condition, and verse 21 tells how he puts her under the curse before giving its words. The Hebrew gives the condition here and the curse there.

decisions.choice: a man has given his lying in you: a man has had intercourse with you
decisions.reason: This is another plain legal expression for sexual intercourse (Leviticus 18:20, 23; 20:15).
Literal and Balanced end the verse with a dash to show that the sentence is broken off and taken up again in verse 21. Readable makes the condition its own sentences.

source.text: וְהִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ הַכֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת־הָֽאִשָּׁה֮ בִּשְׁבֻעַ֣ת הָאָלָה֒ וְאָמַ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה אוֹתָ֛ךְ לְאָלָ֥ה וְלִשְׁבֻעָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמֵּ֑ךְ בְּתֵ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־יְרֵכֵךְ֙ נֹפֶ֔לֶת וְאֶת־בִּטְנֵ֖ךְ צָבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and shall make swear the priest the woman with [the] oath of the curse, and shall say the priest to the woman: may make Yahweh you as a curse and as an oath in [the] midst of your people, when makes Yahweh your thigh falling and your belly swollen;

en.L: then the priest shall make the woman swear with the oath of the curse, and the priest shall say to the woman, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make you a curse and an oath in the midst of your people, when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} makes your thigh fall away and your belly swell;
en.B: then the priest is to make the woman swear the oath of the curse, and he is to say to her, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} make you a byword in curses and oaths among your people, when {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} makes your thigh waste away and your belly swell.

es.B: entonces el sacerdote hará que la mujer pronuncie el juramento de la maldición, y le dirá: ‘Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga de ti un ejemplo que tu pueblo nombre en sus maldiciones y juramentos, cuando {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga que tu muslo se consuma y tu vientre se hinche.

am.L: ካህኑም ሴቲቱን የእርግማኑን መሐላ ያስምላታል፤ ካህኑም ሴቲቱን እንዲህ ይላታል፦ ‘{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጭንሽን በሚያሰልልበትና ሆድሽን በሚያሳብጥበት ጊዜ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝብሽ መካከል መረገሚያና መማሊያ ያድርግሽ፤
am.B: ካህኑ የእርግማኑን መሐላ ሴቲቱን ያስምላት፤ እንዲህም ይበላት፦ ‘{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጭንሽን በሚያመነምንበትና ሆድሽን በሚያሳብጥበት ጊዜ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕዝብሽ ሲራገሙና ሲምሉ የሚጠሩሽ ምሳሌ ያድርግሽ።
am.R: ከዚያም ካህኑ ሴቲቱን የእርግማኑን መሐላ ማስማል አለበት። እንዲህም ይላታል፦ ‘በደለኛ ከሆንሽ ሕዝብሽ ሲራገሙና ሲምሉ ስምሽን እንዲጠሩ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ያድርግ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ማኅፀንሽ እንዲኮማተር፣ ሆድሽም እንዲያብጥ ያድርግ።

decisions.choice: make you a curse and an oath: make you an example people name when they curse or swear
alternatives: make you accursed and sworn against
decisions.reason: To become "a curse" is to suffer so plainly that others use your name in their curses: "May the LORD make you like her." Jeremiah 29:22 gives such a curse, and Isaiah 65:15 speaks of a name left behind "for a curse".

decisions.choice: your thigh falling and your belly swelling: harm to her body that ends her ability to bear children
alternatives: a wasting disease of the body
miscarriage of a child conceived in adultery
decisions.reason: "Thigh" is a polite word for the reproductive organs; children are said to come "out of the thigh" of their father (Genesis 46:26; Exodus 1:5). What exactly is meant is not certain: it may be a miscarriage, a fallen womb, or the loss of fertility. Verse 28 sets against it the promise that an innocent woman will conceive, so the curse at least means she will be unable to have children.

decisions.choice: when the LORD makes: the outcome is the LORD's doing
decisions.reason: The priest does not claim that the water works by itself. It is the LORD who brings the curse, if it comes, because only he knows what happened in secret (verse 13).

decisions.choice: then the priest shall make the woman swear: the narration takes up the oath broken off in verse 20
decisions.reason: After the condition of verse 20, this verse first says that the priest puts her under the curse, then gives the curse in his own words.

decisions.choice: a byword in curses and oaths
decisions.reason: Balanced says "byword" to show that the woman's name, not she herself, becomes the curse people repeat. Literal keeps "a curse and an oath".

decisions.choice: your womb shrink
decisions.reason: Readable says "womb" for "thigh", following the meaning decision that the word refers to the organs of childbearing. Literal and Balanced keep "thigh".

decisions.choice: If you are guilty
decisions.reason: Readable repeats the condition of verse 20, which Literal and Balanced leave hanging before the curse.

decisions.choice: "ton sein maternel" for "womb"
alternatives: "ta cuisse" as at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Readable names the organs of childbearing, as the English does (m2). "Le sein maternel" is the usual French way of naming the womb in a Bible; "utérus" is a medical word. The same wording returns in verses 22 and 27.

decisions.choice: "mji wa uzazi" for "womb"
decisions.reason: Readable names the womb, as the English does (m2). "Mji wa uzazi" is the common Swahili term and keeps it apart from "tumbo" (belly), which is in the same sentence.

decisions.choice: "đùi ... teo đi" (L, B), "dạ con ... teo lại" (R); "bụng ... phình lên"
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew "thigh"; Readable says "dạ con" (womb), as the English Readable does, because the meaning decision says the harm ends her ability to bear children.

decisions.choice: "넓적다리" for the thigh at Literal and Balanced; "태" (womb) at Readable
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew body word, which the footnoted meaning decision explains as harm that ends her ability to bear children; Readable follows the English Readable in naming the womb.

decisions.choice: a sua coxa definhar e o seu ventre inchar (L, B); o seu útero murchar e a sua barriga inchar (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "coxa", the polite word the Hebrew uses for the organs of childbearing (m2), as the English keeps "thigh". Readable says "útero", as the English Readable says "womb", and then "barriga", since Portuguese "ventre" also means womb and would blur the two parts of the curse.

decisions.choice: faça do seu nome uma maldição e uma fórmula de juramento
alternatives: faça de você um exemplo de maldição
decisions.reason: Balanced says that her name becomes what people say when they curse or swear (m1), as the English "byword"; Portuguese has no single word for it.

decisions.choice: Literal and Balanced put the "when" clause before the wish ("{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጭንሽን በሚያሰልልበት ... ጊዜ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ... ያድርግሽ")
decisions.reason: Amharic puts a time clause before its main verb; both mentions of the name stay. Readable makes two wishes, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ጭን" (thigh) with "ማሰለል" (L) and "ማመንመን" (B) for "fall away, waste away"; "ማኅፀን" (womb) with "መኮማተር" (shrink) at Readable
decisions.reason: As the English levels: the thigh is kept at Literal and Balanced; Readable names the womb, since the harm ends her ability to bear children (m2).

ko.L: 그리고 저주를 가져오는 이 물이 네 창자 속으로 들어가서, [네] 배를 부어오르게 하고 [네] 넓적다리를 떨어지게 하기를 바란다." 그러면 그 여자는 "아멘, 아멘" 하고 말해야 한다.

pt.L: e entrem estas águas que trazem a maldição nas suas entranhas, para fazer inchar [o seu] ventre e definhar [a sua] coxa." E a mulher dirá: "Amém, amém."
pt.B: Que esta água que traz a maldição entre em você e faça o seu ventre inchar e a sua coxa definhar." E a mulher dirá: "Amém, amém."

am.L: ይህም እርግማን የሚያመጣው ውኃ ሆድሽን ሊያሳብጥ ጭንሽንም ሊያሰልል ወደ አንጀትሽ ይግባ።’ ሴቲቱም እንዲህ ትላለች፦ ‘አሜን፤ አሜን።’

decisions.choice: and may this water go: the curse continues as a wish
decisions.reason: The verb form follows the wish of verse 21 ("may the LORD make you") and continues it. It could also be read as a statement of what the water will do, but either way it is part of the curse the woman accepts.

decisions.choice: Amen, amen: so be it
decisions.reason: "Amen" means "it is true" or "let it be so". By saying it the woman takes the oath and its curse on herself (Deuteronomy 27:15-26). Saying it twice makes the answer solemn (Nehemiah 8:6; Psalm 41:14).

decisions.choice: inward parts: the inside of the body
decisions.reason: The word means the inner organs, the belly or womb. The water goes into her body and takes effect there, as verse 21 describes.

decisions.choice: womb
decisions.reason: As in verse 21.

en.R: Then the priest must write these curses on a scroll. He must wash the ink off into the bitter water.

es.L: Y el sacerdote escribirá estas maldiciones en un rollo y [las] borrará en las aguas de amargura.
